We are growing fast and we are looking for a Virtual Assistant who wants to grow with us. This is not a place to sit on the sidelines. We want someone who takes ownership, works well inside a team, and genuinely cares about making our clients' lives easier. If you do great work, you will be rewarded for it and you will grow as the agency grows.



What You Will Be Doing



The majority of your work will be messaging. You will be communicating with customers and leads on behalf of our clients, which means your written English needs to be proficient and professional. Clear, natural, well written messages are at the core of this role.

Alongside the messaging, you will help manage client workflows and automations, handle customer service tasks, and keep our systems running smoothly so nothing slips through the cracks. Over time, the right person will take on more responsibility and become a core part of how we operate.



The Schedule



This is a full time role, 6 days a week, made up of 6 x 8 hour days. You must be available to work weekends. Please only apply if this schedule works for you long term.

What We Are Looking For

Proficient written English. This is essential. The majority of your work is messaging, so clear, professional, natural sounding communication is non negotiable.

Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) or another CRM. If you have built workflows, managed pipelines, or worked inside a CRM before, tell us about it.

A background in customer service or messaging. You understand how to talk to people, stay calm, and keep conversations moving.

Stable, reliable internet. This is essential. We need you online and dependable during your working hours.

Reliability and availability. We are looking for someone who can commit to consistent hours, including weekends, without heavy outside responsibilities pulling them away. This is about being dependable for the long term.



How to Apply



Please copy the questions below into your application and answer each one. Applications that do not answer these questions will not be considered.



1. Tell us about your experience with GoHighLevel or any other CRM. What have you built or managed inside it?

2. Describe your background in customer service or messaging. What kind of customers or conversations have you handled?

3. Why do you want to join a growing marketing agency, and what does growing with a company mean to you?

4. Attach a screenshot of an internet speed test taken from where you will be working.

5. This role is 6 x 8 hour days per week and requires weekend availability. Does this schedule work for you long term? Please confirm.

6. Do you currently have any major outside commitments that could affect your availability or reliability, such as caring for young children, caring for a family member or loved one, or a second job? Please be honest. We are simply making sure the role is a good fit for both sides.

7. What are your available working hours in your local time and your time zone?



We read every application properly, so take your time and put your best foot forward. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator
description:
# **Admin / Transaction Coordinator (ATC) – Curative Title Real Estate (Florida Market)**



## **Overview**



We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company specializing in **curative title and probate-related transactions**. We acquire properties with title issues by working directly with property owners and heirs.



We are seeking a **detail-oriented Admin / Transaction Coordinator (ATC)** to manage files **after contracts are signed**, ensuring all documents are properly executed, tracked, and delivered to our probate attorney.



This role is a hybrid of:



* Transaction coordination

* Light probate support

* Document preparation

* Project management



This is **not a sales role**.



20 - 30 hours per week



---



## **Primary Objective**



Move signed deals from **contract ? executed documents ? attorney submission ? case tracking**, with zero errors and full visibility.



---



## **Key Responsibilities**



### **1. Seller & Heir Coordination**



* Communicate with sellers and heirs after agreements are signed

* Provide clear instructions for document signing

* Maintain a professional, respectful tone (many cases involve deceased family members)



---



### **2. Mobile Notary Coordination**



* Locate and schedule **local mobile notaries anywhere in the U.S.**



* Coordinate time, location, and document requirements



* Provide notary with:



  * Document package

  * Signing instructions

  * FedEx shipping label



* Send tracking links to sellers and monitor delivery



---



### **3. Document Preparation & Quality Control**



Prepare and review:



* Quitclaim Deeds

* Joinders

* Assignments of Interest

* Affidavits of Heirship

* ID verification (driver’s licenses)



Ensure:



* Names match exactly across all documents

* Proper vesting language

* No missing signatures, initials, or notary sections



---



### **4. Document Flow Management**



* Receive scanned documents from notary

* Review for completeness and accuracy

* Submit completed files to probate attorney

* Track original documents via FedEx



---



### **5. Case Tracking & Attorney Coordination**



* Maintain status of each deal (pipeline management)

* Communicate with probate attorney for updates

* Identify bottlenecks and follow up proactively

* Provide internal team with status updates



---



### **6. Data Entry & Research Support**



* Review obituaries and public records



* Identify possible heirs and ownership clues



* Check for:



  * Liens

  * Judgments

  * Ownership inconsistencies



* Update CRM / tracking sheets accurately



---



## **Required Skills & Experience**



### **Core Competencies**



* Extremely detail-oriented (zero-error mindset)

* Strong organizational and follow-through skills

* Excellent written and verbal English

* Ability to manage multiple files simultaneously



---



### **Technical Skills**



* Google Sheets / Excel (intermediate)

* Document handling (PDF editing, file organization)

* Familiarity with CRM systems (preferred)

* Comfortable using FedEx/UPS shipping tools



---



### **Relevant Experience (Preferred)**



* Transaction Coordinator (Real Estate)

* Title Company / Escrow Assistant

* Probate or Legal Assistant

* Virtual Assistant (real estate or legal support)



---



### **Industry Knowledge (Strongly Preferred)**



* Basic understanding of:



  * Probate process

  * Heirship / inheritance

  * Deeds and title transfers



---



## **DISC Profile – Ideal Candidate**



### **Target Profile: High C / Moderate S**



**Dominance (D): Low–Moderate (15–30%)**



* Not aggressive or pushy

* Patient and process-driven



**Influence (I): Moderate (20–40%)**



* Able to communicate clearly with sellers and heirs

* Builds trust without “selling”



**Steadiness (S): High (30–45%)**



* Consistent, reliable, calm under pressure

* Handles repetitive processes well



**Compliance (C): Very High (30–50%)**



* Precision-focused

* Follows structured processes

* Strong attention to detail



---



### **What This Role Is NOT Suited For**



* High-D, aggressive personalities (too fast, error-prone)

* High-I, talkative but disorganized candidates

* Creative types who dislike structured processes



---



## **Ideal Previous Roles (Top Fits)**



Candidates who have worked as:



1. **Real Estate Transaction Coordinator (U.S. market)**

2. **Title Company Processor / Escrow Assistant**

3. **Probate or Legal Administrative Assistant**

4. **Mortgage Processing Assistant**

5. **Document Control Specialist (high-compliance industries)**



---



## **Key Traits for Success**



* Obsessive attention to detail

* Strong follow-up habits (nothing falls through the cracks)

* Ability to think logically through ownership scenarios

* Comfortable working with sensitive family situations

* Process-oriented and checklist-driven



---



## **Performance Metrics**



* % of files completed without errors

* Turnaround time from contract ? signed documents

* Document rejection rate (attorney feedback)

* Number of files successfully moved to probate



---



## **Working Hours**



* Must overlap with U.S. business hours (Eastern Time preferred)



---



## **Why This Role Matters**



You will be the **central operator** ensuring deals actually close.

Without this role, signed contracts do not convert into revenue.



---



> To apply send an
 to 
 with the subject: Admin/Transaction Coordinator



Include:

>

> 1. A short voice recording introducing yourself

> 2. Your DISC profile (D % + I % + S % + C % = 100%) - 

> 3. A brief description of any experience with real estate or legal documents

title: QA, Release & Platform Engineer
description:
About The Product



We are building a B2B SaaS platform focused on marketing attribution, conversion tracking, revenue measurement and privacy-conscious data collection.



The platform helps businesses understand the difference between platform-reported performance and actual business outcomes by connecting advertising platforms, websites, CRM systems and revenue sources.



Because the platform operates in a privacy-sensitive environment and processes attribution, tracking and revenue data, accuracy, reliability and data integrity are critical.



Our customers rely on the platform to make marketing and business decisions. A bug, release issue or implementation mistake can impact reporting, attribution, revenue calculations, privacy-related functionality and customer trust.



We are looking for a technically strong engineer who can help ensure the platform remains stable, secure, maintainable and production-ready as it grows.



?



The Role



We are looking for a Part-Time QA, Release & Platform Engineer who will act as an independent technical reviewer and quality gate between development and production.



Your primary responsibility is ensuring that software quality, release quality and infrastructure quality remain high as the product evolves.



You will work closely with the lead developer and founder while maintaining an independent technical perspective.



You will help ensure that bugs, regressions, deployment mistakes, security risks and technical debt are identified before they impact customers.



This role combines:



* Quality Assurance

* Release Management

* Code Review

* Infrastructure Oversight

* Technical Documentation

* Occasional Hands-On Engineering



?



Technical Stack



You should be comfortable reviewing and working with a modern TypeScript-first SaaS stack.



Languages



* TypeScript

* SQL (PostgreSQL)



Frontend



* Next.js 14

* React

* App Router

* Tailwind CSS

* shadcn/ui



Backend



* Bun

* Hono

* Prisma

* Kysely

* Better Auth



Data & Queueing



* PostgreSQL 16

* JSONB

* Row Level Security (RLS)

* Redis

* BullMQ



Integrations



* Stripe Billing

* Usage Metering

* Resend

* React



Infrastructure



* Hetzner Kubernetes Engine

* Kubernetes Secrets

* S3-compatible storage

* GitHub Actions

* ArgoCD

* Grafana

* Loki

* Prometheus



You do not need to be an expert in every tool, but you should be senior enough to understand how these systems interact and be able to identify risks and improvement opportunities.



?



Responsibilities



Quality Assurance & Testing



You will be responsible for validating new functionality before it reaches production.



This includes:



* Feature validation

* Regression testing

* Release testing

* Acceptance testing

* Bug reproduction

* Integration testing

* User flow testing

* Tracking validation

* Revenue attribution validation

* Test gate improvements



You should be comfortable validating functionality across:



* Frontend applications

* APIs

* Tracking systems

* CRM integrations

* Revenue integrations

* Reporting systems

* Customer onboarding flows

* User permissions and access controls

* Privacy and consent-related functionality



The goal is simple:



Prevent bugs, regressions and incorrect data from reaching production.



?



Code Review & Technical Oversight



You will regularly review development work and provide technical feedback.



You should be comfortable reviewing:



Frontend



* Next.js

* React

* TypeScript

* User flows

* Responsive behaviour

* Product requirements



Backend



* Bun

* Hono

* APIs

* Authentication flows

* Database interactions

* Business logic

* Data processing workflows



Your focus is not only whether code works, but whether it is:



* Maintainable

* Scalable

* Secure

* Well structured

* Consistent with project standards



You should be able to identify:



* Technical debt

* Architectural risks

* Security risks

* Privacy-related implementation risks

* Improper handling of sensitive data

* Permission and access control issues



?



GitHub, CI/CD & Release Management



You will help maintain a professional software delivery process.



This includes:



* Branching strategies

* Pull request workflows

* Protected branches

* Merge policies

* GitHub Actions

* CI/CD pipelines

* Release validation

* Deployment workflows

* Staging reviews

* Production release reviews

* Rollback planning



You should be comfortable improving and expanding test coverage and release safeguards over time.



?



Infrastructure Oversight



You do not need to be a dedicated DevOps engineer.



However, you should be comfortable reviewing infrastructure health and identifying operational risks.



This includes:



* Kubernetes environments

* Docker environments

* Deployment health

* Monitoring dashboards

* Logs and alerts

* Resource usage

* Environment configuration

* Secrets management

* Access control reviews

* Security-related deployment risks



You should be able to identify potential issues and work with developers to resolve them before they become production problems.



?



Technical Contributions



While the primary focus of this role is quality assurance, release management and technical oversight, you should also be comfortable making occasional technical improvements and fixes when appropriate.



Examples include:



* Small frontend fixes

* Small backend fixes

* CI/CD improvements

* GitHub workflow improvements

* Documentation improvements

* Monitoring improvements

* Configuration changes

* Infrastructure-related improvements



You will not be responsible for building major product features, but you should be comfortable contributing directly to the codebase when needed.



?



Documentation



You will help maintain:



* Technical documentation

* Release procedures

* Deployment documentation

* Operational playbooks

* Testing procedures

* I
 documentation



?



Requirements



Must Have



* Strong experience with TypeScript

* Strong experience with Next.js and React

* Strong experience reviewing backend application code

* Experience with modern TypeScript backend frameworks or runtimes

* Strong understanding of APIs and backend service design

* Strong understanding of PostgreSQL and SQL

* Experience with GitHub pull request workflows

* Experience with GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines

* Experience reviewing code for maintainability, security and scalability

* Strong understanding of QA and release management processes

* Strong written and spoken English



Nice To Have



* Bun experience

* Hono experience

* Prisma experience

* Kysely experience

* PostgreSQL Row Level Security experience

* Redis / BullMQ experience

* Kubernetes experience

* ArgoCD experience

* Grafana, Loki or Prometheus experience

* Stripe Billing experience

* Application security experience

* Privacy/GDPR-sensitive product experience

* SaaS analytics or attribution product experience



?



Compensation



* Part-time position

* Approximately 8-12 hours per week

* Additional hours only with prior approval



?



What Success Looks Like



* GitHub workflows are clean and protected

* Releases are predictable and well-tested

* CI/CD pipelines are reliable

* Test coverage has improved

* Technical debt is visible and controlled

* Infrastructure is stable and monitored

* Security and privacy risks are identified early

* Frontend implementations match requirements

* Bugs and regressions are caught before production

* Developers receive actionable technical feedback



In short, your role is to ensure that poor code, broken functionality, infrastructure issues and risky releases never reach production while helping maintain a high engineering standard across the platform.

description:
Hello!

We are Virtual Xposure, a fast-growing real estate media and marketing company in Canada.

Our mission is simple: We help real estate agents sell their listings faster, sell for more money, and save time through elite media and marketing.

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-driven Virtual Assistant from the Philippines to join our team as a Project Manager VA — long-term.

If you love keeping things running smoothly, making sure nothing falls through the cracks, and helping a fast-moving team stay on track, we want to meet you.

Type the words GREEN LIGHT in the first sentence of your application so we know you read the full job description.



About Our Company

Virtual Xposure works with real estate agents across Canada to deliver professional listing photos, videos, virtual tours, and marketing content.

Our clients depend on us to deliver fast, flawless results — every single time.

To do that, our internal team needs to run like clockwork. That's where you come in.

Our team culture focuses on:

Integrity

Hospitality

Continuous Improvement

Assign tasks to the right tea

Scheduling & Operations

Manage calendar logistics across multiple tea
mbers

Track job progress from booking to final delivery



Communication & Reporting



Serve as the internal point of contact between departments

Send daily or weekly status updates to leadership

Communicate clearly with tea
mbers to resolve blockers

Keep a clean paper trail — every task documented, every update logged



Administrative Support



CRM updates and data entry

Inbox and task organization

Process documentation and SOPs

Research tasks as needed





What We're Looking For

Required:

Strong organizational skills — you don't let things slip

Experience with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or similar)

Long-term job stability

Develop real operational and leadership skills

Have a clear path toward a senior operations role

Be part of a team that values your contribution



Many of our tea

title: Head of Operations / Business Operations Manager for 3M/m Subscription Business
description:
We are a fast growing subscription ecommerce brand operating across DTC, Amazon, paid media, subscription billing, payment processing, fulfillment, customer service, retention, and finance.



We are looking for a highly organized, data driven Head of Operations / Business Operations Manager to become the operational right hand to the CEO.



This person will help create structure across the business by managing reporting, tracking projects, identifying bottlenecks, improving workflows, and making sure every department is clear on what they own.



This is not a basic admin role. We need someone who understands ecommerce, can work with data, can manage multiple departments, and can bring clarity to a fast moving business.



Main Goal



Your main goal is to help the CEO run the business with better visibility, better execution, and better accountability.



You should be able to look at the business and clearly answer:



What is happening?

Where is the bottleneck?

Who owns the problem?

What needs to happen next?

Is it getting done?

Is the reporting clear enough to make good decisions?

Responsibilities

Reporting and Business Visibility

Manage the company’s daily operating dashboard

Make sure departments update reports accurately and on time

Build and improve dashboards, trackers, and reporting systems

Create clear daily, weekly, and monthly reporting for the CEO

Help define and track KPIs across departments

Turn raw data into clear insights and action points

Data and Analytics

Work with tools such as Google Sheets, Looker Studio, Shopify, CheckoutChamp, Amazon Seller Central, Triple Whale, Northbeam, payment processors, ad platforms, and other ecommerce tools

Pull data from different platforms and organize it clearly

Build formulas, dashboards, and data views

Spot data issues or inconsistencies between platforms

Help automate reporting where possible

Department Coordination

Act as the link between the CEO and department owners

Coordinate across marketing, finance, CRO, payments, retention, customer service, fulfillment, and agencies

Make sure every department knows what they are responsible for

Follow up on projects, timelines, action items, and deliverables

Keep agencies and internal tea
mbers aligned with company priorities

Push for accountability without creating unnecessary complexity

Bottleneck Detection and Problem Solving

Review daily and weekly metrics to identify issues early

Spot problems across marketing, funnel conversion, payments, retention, fulfillment, refunds, chargebacks, inventory, and cashflow

Escalate problems clearly with context and suggested next steps

Turn messy business problems into clear action plans

Help create systems to prevent recurring problems

Project Management and Workflow Improvement

Manage key projects across departments using tools like ClickUp, Notion, Asana, Monday, Slack, Google Sheets, and Google Drive

Build task boards, SOPs, checklists, meeting agendas, and reporting rhythms

Make sure work is tracked properly and nothing gets missed

Improve workflows as the company scales

Keep the team organized and moving fast

Ecommerce Areas You Should Understand



You do not need to be an expert in every area, but you should understand enough to ask smart questions, spot issues, and coordinate the right people.



Relevant areas include:



DTC ecommerce

Shopify

CheckoutChamp or similar checkout and CRM systems

Subscription billing and rebills

LTV, retention, churn, and cohort reporting

Paid media, MER, CAC, ROAS, and contribution profit

CRO, funnels, landing pages, AOV, CVR, and upsells

Payment processing, approval rates, declines, chargebacks, reserves, and MIDs

Amazon Seller Central

Customer service, refunds, cancellations, and complaints

Fulfillment, 3PLs, inventory, and shipping performance

Basic ecommerce finance and cashflow

What Success Looks Like



In the first 30 to 60 days, success looks like:



The daily operating dashboard is clearly maintained

Each department has clear KPIs, owners, and reporting

The CEO has a clear view of daily performance and bottlenecks

Meeting action items are tracked and followed up on

Agencies and internal tea
mbers have clearer accountability

Major operational gaps are identified and prioritized

Reporting becomes cleaner, faster, and more useful

The business feels more organized and less reactive



Long term, success looks like:



The company has a strong operating system

Department owners are accountable to clear numbers

Bottlenecks are identified quickly

Projects move faster with fewer missed details

The CEO can spend more time on strategy and growth because operations are under control

Requirements

Strong ecommerce experience, ideally with subscription or high volume DTC brands

Strong analytical skills

Excellent Google Sheets or Excel skills

Experience building dashboards, trackers, reports, or scorecards

Strong understanding of ecommerce KPIs including revenue, CAC, MER, ROAS, AOV, CVR, LTV, churn, refunds, contribution profit, approval rates, and fulfillment metrics

Strong project management skills

Experience working across multiple teams or departments

Excellent written and verbal communication

Comfortable working with agencies, contractors, and internal tea
mbers

Able to run calls, follow up, push projects forward, and hold people accountable

Highly proactive and able to work without constant direction

Fast learner who can quickly understand new tools and systems

Nice to Have

Experience with Shopify, CheckoutChamp, Amazon Seller Central, Meta Ads, Triple Whale, Northbeam, Looker Studio, Hyros, or similar tools

Experience with supplements, health ecommerce, subscription brands, or performance marketing businesses

Experience with payment processing, chargebacks, approval rates, MIDs, reserves, or rebill optimization

Experience working with ecommerce brands doing $1M+ per month

Experience managing reporting across finance, marketing, CRO, retention, customer service, and fulfillment

Basic understanding of SQL, Zapier, APIs, data connectors, or automation tools

Personality Fit



We are looking for someone who is:



Proactive

Highly organized

Data driven

Commercially minded

Clear in communication

Comfortable with pressure

Fast moving

Detail oriented

Strong at follow through

Able to create clarity from chaos

Comfortable challenging assumptions

A natural leader



You should not wait to be told what to do. You should be able to look at a messy area of the business, understand what is missing, and help build the system to fix it.



Role Summary



This role is for someone who can become the operational right hand to the CEO.



You will help turn a fast growing ecommerce business from reactive and chaotic into clear, accountable, data driven, and execution focused.



The ideal candidate combines:



Project management

Ecommerce understanding

Analytics

Finance awareness

Operational leadership

Strong communication

Proactive problem solving



This is a high impact role with significant responsibility and room to grow.



How to Apply



Please apply with:



Put 'Clarity MD COO' as the subject line so i know youve read all this

A short summary of your ecommerce operations experience

Examples of dashboards, reports, trackers, or operating systems you have built

The ecommerce tools you have worked with

The types of brands you have worked with, including revenue size if possible

One example of a business bottleneck you identified and helped solve

title: Executive Assistant/Operations (Fast Growing)
description:
Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company

Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. 



This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal.



What You Get If You Win Here

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before. 

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!

If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: 

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. 

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding 

I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. 



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. 



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example 

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership. 



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level. 

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.  



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based  (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no rando
etings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.

title: Receptionist (Remote VA Call Handling) Quick Hire, Long-Term Role
description:
Important: Selected applicants will receive a response within 24 hours. Due to the volume of applications, we may move forward with other candidates if we do not receive a timely response.



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a voice-based role, we also offer non-voice positions with a heavier focus on administrative tasks, subject to availability and overall fit.



To apply: Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly.



(1) Where in the Philippines are you currently located? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



(2) Please submit a screenshot of your internet speed and a few samples of your previous work output.



(3) Please submit two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund.



(4) Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.



(5) Are you able to commit to a fixed 7-day, 6-hour work schedule during Central Standard Time (CST) hours? What is your expected hourly or monthly pay rate and earliest physical start date if hired.



(6) Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. For each task, explain the exact step-by-step process you followed, the tools or systems used, and the typical result or output produced.



(7) If you were hired today, what are 3 specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



(8) What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



(9) Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: SALES REPRESENTATIVE - REMOTE, UK-BASED BUSINESS
description:
SALES REPRESENTATIVE – PROPERTY MANAGEMENT (REMOTE, UK-BASED BUSINESS)

We’re looking for a responsible and fast-working Sales Representative to join our small UK-based property management team. This is a long-term position — we value loyalty, reliability, and people who want to grow with the company for many years.



WORKING HOURS

Saturday & Sunday: 8–10 hours each day

3 weekdays: 4–6 hours each

Total: 32–40 hours per week

Office hours: 11:00–21:00 (UK time)



ROLE SUMMARY

You’ll communicate with clients mainly by phone and
, assisting with sales, bookings, payments, cancellations, and general inquiries. You’ll need to think fast, multitask effectively, and handle issues calmly and professionally.



REQUIREMENTS

Fluent English (C1 or higher); experience with UK clients is a plus

Excellent phone and written communication skills

Strong multitasking and problem-solving ability

Reliable, responsible, and committed to long-term work

Proficient computer and Microsoft Office skills

Minimum 2 years of experience in customer support or sales

Own PC/laptop and stable internet connection

Backup plan for power/internet outages



HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV in English.

Include a 1–2 minute voice recording (using Vocaroo or similar) briefly describing your experience, communication style, and why you’d be a great fit for our team.

We’re looking for someone who values teamwork, stability, and takes pride in delivering excellent customer service.

title: High-quality Brand Video Content Editor
description:
WHO WE ARE

We're a Chicago-based photography and videography studio producing high-quality brand films and short-form social content for personal brands and small businesses. We're looking for a skilled video editor to join us long-term.





WHAT YOU'LL EDIT

Brand highlight reels for websites and short-form social clips. 



HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

1. Footage Sent — edit brief & shoot notes on Asana + Google Drive footage link via Slack

2. You edit — download footage, edit per brief, run pre-delivery checklist

3. First cut — upload to 
, post link in Slack

4. Review — timestamped comments in 
 within 24 hours ( Up to two revision rounds)

5. Approval — finals to Google Drive.

6. Payment —  Added to next bi-weekly Wise payment.





RATES

- Short-form clip — $10 (72 hrs) / $15 rush (24 hrs)

- Short-form clip with voiceover — $15 (72 hrs) / $20 rush (24 hrs)

- Brand highlight reel — $35 (5 days) / $50 rush (3 days)

- Brand highlight reel + interview/VO — $45 (5 days) / $65 rush (3 days)



WHAT WE NEED

- 2+ years editing brand films and short-form content

- Strong color grading skills — consistency across mixed footage is essential

- Experience with interviews and voiceover-driven edits

- Reliable internet and clear written English for daily Slack communication

- DaVinci Resolve experience is a strong bonus





HIRING PROCESS

1. Portfolio review — we review your work and shortlist 3–5 candidates

2. Video interview — 15–20 min Zoom call to talk through process and workflow

3. Paid trial task — one real deliverable at the standard rate before committing on either side

4. Offer — if the trial goes well, we move forward



HOW TO APPLY

- Complete our short application form here:

- In your cover note, start with your favorite film and one sentence on why it influences how you edit — then tell us why you're the right editor for ForeverBlue Studio.

title: Social Media Strategist + Viral Content Researcher
description:
We’re a content and media company looking for someone obsessed with social media trends, content strategy, and creating systems that turn ideas into publishable content.



This is NOT a traditional “make Canva posts and schedule content” role.



We want someone who studies what’s working online, identifies repeatable content formats, translates trends into our brand voice, and helps build a content machine.



You’ll work directly with founders and our production/editing team to create a pipeline of content ideas that can actually be filmed and executed.



Your Mission



Your job is to help us consistently create content that grows reach, builds authority, and drives business.



You’ll research what’s performing, break it down into repeatable frameworks, organize content plans, and prepare everything our filming/editing team needs.



Think:

Trend Scout + Content Strategist + Creative Producer.





Responsibilities



1. Weekly Viral Content Research



* Research Instagram Reels/TikToks and emerging content trends

* Identify viral formats—not just trending audios

* Study:

  * hooks

  * structure

  * pacing

  * editing style

  * visual patterns

  * retention mechanics

* Pull examples across multiple industries (not only competitors)



Deliverable:

A curated list of:

* 5 content ideas to recreate per account (4 accounts currently so 20 total)

* For each reel, create an additional 2-3 written/visual hook variations to test in trial reels





 2. Content Strategy + Format Development



For each concept:



* Create filming briefs

* Write proposed hook options

* Recommend B-roll/shots needed

* Outline talking points (if needed)

* Suggest caption angle

* Suggest CTA



Organize everything into Notion.





4. Basic Editing + Posting (Bonus)



Preffered if you can edit basic reels.

For more complex edits, we will pass on to our editors.



* Basic vertical video editing

* Add captions/text overlays

* Trim clips

* Schedule and publish content or create the weekly content schedule.



Tools (preferred):



* CapCut

* Instagram

* TikTok

* Notion

* Google Drive





Ideal Candidate



You might be a fit if:



* You constantly save and analyze content

* You notice patterns before trends become saturated

* You understand WHY videos work—not just that they went viral

* You can think strategically AND execute

* You’re highly organized

* You enjoy turning ideas into systems

* You understand creator-led brands



Bonus:



* Experience managing founder/personal brands

* Familiar with retention editing

* Comfortable writing hooks and captions



Weekly Deliverables



* 20 Pieces of Content Ideas with multiple hooks per week

* Notion content board updated

* Filming briefs prepared if needed

* Basic reels are edited

* Posting schedule

* Performance observations



Suggested work schedule:

Monday: Content Research

Tuesday: We film

Wednesday: You organize footage, send to editors if needed

Thursday: Edit basic reels

Friday: Arrange, and Write Captions, deliver to us



This is just a rough outline but you/we may change as we go through this process.



To Apply



Please send:



1. Short intro video (2–3 min)

2. Links to content accounts you’ve worked on

3. Favorite creator accounts and why

4. Optional: Edit one short-form sample



Subject line:

“Content Machine Builder”

title: CRM & Social Media Virtual Assistant — Mobile Luxury Spa
description:
We are Massages VIP Pro Puerto Rico, a growing mobile luxury spa serving clients island-wide — from private homes and Airbnbs to beaches and resorts. We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to take full ownership of our CRM, lead follow-up, booking coordination, and social media operations.

This is a critical role. We need someone who takes initiative, works independently, and genuinely cares about doing things right. If you need constant supervision this is not the right fit.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN:

CRM & Lead Management:



- Monitor our CRM inbox (AgentCRM / GoHighLevel) every day without exception

- Respond to every new lead within 5 minutes using approved message templates

- Follow up with every unresponsive lead after 24 hours

- Move all leads through the pipeline from first inquiry to confirmed booking

- Tag and organize all contacts by location, service type, and booking status

- Send rebooking messages to our existing database of 500+ past clients

- Prepare a weekly report on leads, response times, conversions, and lost bookings



Booking Coordination:



- Receive confirmed bookings and notify the assigned therapist immediately

- Confirm the appointment with the client right away

- Handle reschedules and cancellations professionally and promptly

- Follow up with every client after their session to ensure satisfaction and encourage rebooking



Automation & Systems:



- Set up and maintain automated responses in AgentCRM

- Build and manage message templates for common client inquiries

- Continuously improve response workflows to reduce manual work and increase speed



Social Media Management:



- Post consistently on Instagram,
, TikTok, and Google Business

- Respond to all DMs and comments within the hour

- Create simple graphics and captions using Canva

- Grow following organically through consistent, engaging content

- Report weekly on engagement and what is working



REQUIREMENTS:



- Proven experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) or AgentCRM — required

- Strong experience managing social media professionally

- Excellent written English — you will communicate directly with clients

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail

- Self-motivated and proactive — you do not wait to be told what to do

- Reliable internet connection

- Available Monday to Sunday, 9am to 6pm Atlantic Standard Time (Puerto Rico)

- Weekend availability is important — most bookings come in Friday to Sunday

- Experience with Canva for social media graphics

- Spanish language skills — preferred but not required



PREFERRED:



- Experience in hospitality, wellness, or spa industry

- Experience building automated message sequences

- Prior experience working with a US or Caribbean-based business



HOW TO APPLY:

Please send the following:



- Your resume

- A short paragraph explaining your GoHighLevel or AgentCRM experience specifically

- Links or screenshots of social media accounts you have managed

- Your available hours and time zone

- Your expected monthly rate



Applications without GoHighLevel or CRM experience will not be considered. We respond to every qualified applicant and are looking to hire as soon as possible.

title: Operations & Project Manager (Fast Growing)
description:
Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company



Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. 



This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal.



What You Get If You Win Here

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before. 

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!

If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: 

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. 

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding 

I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. 



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. 



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example 

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership. 



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level. 

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.  



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based  (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no rando
etings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to. 

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit. 



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test) Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)



If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.



Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:



Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):

Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro
ssy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.” 

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.

Q4:  Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list):

– “Fix Asana, it’s a mess”

– “Seller lead texting follow up??”

– “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ”

– “Inventory backlog insane”

– “Need better reporting”

– “Update SOPs

In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager.

In a Google Doc, please:



Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.” 

Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points.



Link the Google Doc here (view access).



Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying.



Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example 

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership. 



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level. 

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.  



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based  (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no rando
etings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to. 

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit. 



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test)

Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)

If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.



Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:

Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):

Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro
ssy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.” 

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.

Q4:  Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list):

– “Fix Asana, it’s a mess”

– “Seller lead texting follow up??”

– “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ”

– “Inventory backlog insane”

– “Need better reporting”

– “Update SOPs

In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager.



1. In a Google Doc, please:



Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.” 



2. Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points.



3. Link the Google Doc here (view access).

Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying.



Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

 Full script

All final animations and assets created for the channel belong to BattlePaws

Applicants are first filtered based on:



 Portfolio quality

 Communication

 Responsiveness

 Compatibility with the channel style

This first pass is mainly used to remove low-effort or incompatible applicants and is not heavily scored.

5. Animation software you use most

6. Your time zone (so we know if we can sync via WhatsApp)

Applications that don't include all six items above, or that don't start with "Legion," will be ignored.



Step 2 — Paid Animation Test

Selected applicants from Step 1 will be invited to a paid animation test.

The test materials are hosted in this read-only Google Drive folder:







Inside you'll find:



 The full brief (READ FIRST/)

 3 scenes of script + voice-over + storyboard images (References/, Storyboards/, Voice Over/)

 A preview MP4 showing scene-change timing

 Channel style references and mascot turntable

The storyboard is creative guidance, not strict frame-by-frame instructions. Creative improvements are welcome if they fit the channel style.



The test evaluates:



 Pacing

 Comedic timing

 Visual clarity

 Ability to follow instructions

 Communication

 Workflow organization

 Overall YouTube retention quality



Technical requirements: 



 Resolution: 1920 × 1080

 Frame rate: 30 fps

 Export format: MP4 (H.264)



Required deliverables:



 Final MP4 export

 Project files

 Assets used during production



Time & deadline: 



 Approximately 4–6 hours of work expected

 Smooth animation is not the priority — strong storytelling, efficient workflow, and engaging pacing matter more



How to submit:



When finished, upload your deliverables (MP4, project files, assets) to your own Google Drive folder set to view-only, then submit the link via our submission form:







The form takes ~1 minute to fill out. Do not
 files directly — the form is the only submission channel.



Step 3 — Final Selection :

The later stages of recruitment become much more selective. The final decision is based on:

 Reliability

 Communication

 Speed

 Consistency

 Ability to work long-term within the BattlePaws production pipeline



If you're officially selected after the test phase, you receive a $75 USD bonus alongside your first project's compensation.

Payment structure



 Month 1: paid per video at the starting rate

 Month 2+: increased per-video pay for strong performance

 Long-term top performers: transition into a stable full-time position with performance bonuses tied to video success



Ready to apply?



Send your application via this job post. Follow the 6-item checklist in Step 1 above — that's the only thing we check at the first pass.



We respond to all serious applications, even if it's a 'no' — silence isn't our style.



Looking forward to seeing your work.

— The BattlePaws Team
