title: SENIOR MARKETING & CHANNEL SPECIALIST | ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS
description:
SENIOR MARKETING & CHANNEL SPECIALIST



ABOUT ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS



Elevated Hospitality Partners is a growing vacation rental management platform supporting multiple local hospitality brands across Texas, New Mexico, and California. We manage high-quality vacation homes with a focus on strong homeowner partnerships, thoughtful guest experiences, local market expertise, and disciplined operational execution.



As we continue to grow, we are building a centralized marketing function that supports all of our markets, improves the performance of our listings, strengthens our homeowner acquisition efforts, and helps us present a consistent, premium brand across every channel.



ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and creative Senior Marketing & Channel Specialist to support marketing across our vacation rental portfolio.



This role will report to our Chief Commercial Officer and work closely with our market teams, revenue management, onboarding, field operations, and external marketing partners.



This is a hands-on marketing role focused on listing optimization, channel content quality, website updates, homeowner acquisition marketing, referral channel support, brand consistency, and select social media support. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, comfortable with digital tools, highly organized, and excited to help build scalable marketing processes for a growing hospitality business.



This role is especially important because our listings, websites, homeowner-facing content, and referral channels directly impact our ability to grow revenue, attract new homeowners, and create a premium brand experience across every market.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



LISTING OPTIMIZATION & CHANNEL CONTENT

* Own the quality, consistency, and optimization of property listings across Guesty, Airbnb, Vrbo, Google Vacation Rentals, direct booking websites, and other distribution channels.

* Write and refine listing titles, descriptions, summaries, photo captions, amenity highlights, and market-specific content.

* Review listings for completeness, accuracy, conversion quality, and brand consistency.

* Help determine the best hero images, photo order, captions, and property highlights for each listing.

* Coordinate with market teams to confirm property details, amenities, local recommendations, and unique selling points.

* Manage the listing optimization checklist for new and existing homes.

* Support the launch of new listings by ensuring marketing content is complete, accurate, and on-brand before going live.

* Review underperforming listings and recommend content, photo, or positioning improvements.

* Manage the relationship with photography partners to help ensure property photography is high quality, consistent, and aligned with our brand standards.

* Coordinate photography needs, shot lists, photo feedback, and follow-up requests with market teams and external photographers.



WEBSITE & DIRECT BOOKING SUPPORT

* Maintain and update property pages, market pages, owner-facing pages, and other website content.

* Ensure direct booking websites are accurate, polished, and aligned with current listings and brand standards.

* Support the creation of landing pages for market-specific campaigns, homeowner acquisition, and referral partners.

* Help improve website content for SEO, readability, and conversion.

* Coordinate with website vendors or internal tea
mbers when technical changes are needed.

* Support updates to Google Business Profiles and other local search assets.



HOMEOWNER ACQUISITION MARKETING

* Support marketing efforts designed to attract new vacation rental homeowners.

* Help create and maintain homeowner-facing materials, including one-pagers, brochures, market summaries, case studies, listing improvement examples, and sales support materials.

* Support
 campaigns, nurture sequences, and other marketing efforts for prospective homeowners.

* Help package the EHP value proposition clearly across markets, including our approach to home care, revenue management, guest experience, and owner communication.

* Create market-specific content that helps homeowners understand why our local teams are the right partner for their vacation rental.



REFERRAL CHANNEL MARKETING

* Support marketing efforts for referral partners, including real estate agents, brokers, developers, designers, contractors, and other local professionals who may refer homeowners to us.

* Help create referral partner collateral, outreach materials,
 campaigns, and follow-up content.

* Maintain referral channel marketing assets and ensure they are professional, clear, and easy for partners to share.

* Support the marketing side of our lifetime value of leads strategy, helping us stay visible and valuable to referral sources over time.

* Coordinate with leadership and market teams to identify partner opportunities and create simple, repeatable campaigns.



BRAND & CONTENT CONSISTENCY

* Help maintain consistent brand voice, tone, and visual standards across all markets and channels.

* Create and manage templates for listings, owner marketing, referral partners, social media, presentations, and website content.

* Use tools like Canva and Google Workspace to produce clean, professional, on-brand marketing materials.

* Ensure each local brand feels personal and market-specific while still reflecting the quality and standards of Elevated Hospitality Partners.



REPORTING & PROCESS MANAGEMENT

* Maintain a marketing tracker for listing optimization, website updates, referral marketing, owner acquisition campaigns, and active projects.

* Provide regular updates to the Chief Commercial Officer on progress, priorities, and blockers.

* Track key marketing activity, including listings optimized, new listings launched, website pages updated, referral materials created, and campaigns supported.

* Help build repeatable marketing processes as we scale across markets.

* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and quality across our marketing work.



SOCIAL MEDIA

* Support social media content across our brands, with a primary focus on homeowner brand awareness and homeowner acquisition rather than guest marketing.

* Create and maintain a simple content calendar focused on brand credibility, homeowner education, market presence, property highlights, team stories, and referral partner visibility.

* Repurpose listing content, market insights, owner-facing content, and local stories into social media posts.

* Create professional, on-brand graphics and short-form content using Canva or similar tools.

* Ensure social media supports the broader business goal of building trust with homeowners and referral partners.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* Listings are polished, accurate, compelling, and consistent across channels.

* New homes are launched with complete and high-quality marketing content.

* Website and direct booking content stays current and professional.

* Homeowner acquisition materials are organized, clear, and easy for the sales team to use.

* Referral partner marketing is consistent and professional.

* Photography partners receive clear direction and deliver brand-aligned property photos.

* Marketing projects are tracked, prioritized, and completed on time.

* The company has stronger marketing systems that can scale across multiple markets.



IDEAL CANDIDATE

* Excellent written English and strong editing skills.

* Experience in digital marketing, hospitality marketing, vacation rental marketing, real estate marketing, or a similar field.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage many listings, projects, and deadlines.

* Experience writing marketing copy for websites, listings,
s, or social media.

* Comfort working with digital platforms, website builders, channel tools, spreadsheets, and project trackers.

* Strong Canva or basic graphic design skills.

* Good understanding of brand consistency and premium presentation.

* Ability to work independently, ask smart questions, and organize work clearly.

* A proactive, problem-solving mindset.

* Interest in hospitality, travel, real estate, and vacation rentals.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience with any of the following is helpful, but not required:

* Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, or Google Vacation Rentals

* Guesty or another property management system

* Vacation rental or short-term rental marketing

* Real estate or property management marketing

* Website CMS tools

* Google Business Profile

* Google Analytics

* Meta Business Suite

*
 marketing tools

* SEO basics

* Photography coordination or creative direction



TOOLS YOU MAY USE

* Guesty

* Airbnb

* Vrbo

* Google Vacation Rentals

* Google Workspace

* Canva

* Meta Business Suite

* Google Business Profile

* Website builder tools

* Project management or tracking tools

* AI writing and productivity tools



COMPENSATION

* Full-time remote role based in the Philippines

* Compensation: $1,200-$1,500 USD per month, depending on experience

* 13th month pay

* Full-time schedule

* 90-day performance and compensation review

* Long-term growth opportunity as our marketing function expands



WORKING HOURS

• This is a full-time role aligned to U.S. Central Time.

• Required schedule: 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time, Monday-Friday.

• 9:00am-5:00pm CDT = 10:00pm-6:00am PHT.

• Because the Philippines does not observe daylight saving time, the Philippines time equivalent may shift when the U.S. changes between CDT and CST.

• Candidates must be comfortable working overnight Philippines hours on a consistent basis.





APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



To apply, please submit the following:



1. RESUME OR WORK HISTORY

Please share your resume, LinkedIn profile, or a short summary of your relevant work experience.



2. MARKETING PORTFOLIO OR EXAMPLES

Please include examples of marketing work you have created or managed. This could include:



* Vacation rental listings

* Airbnb, Vrbo, or 
 listing copy

* Website pages

* Real estate or hospitality marketing materials

* Social media content

*
 campaigns

* Brochures, one-pagers, or Canva designs

* Before-and-after examples of listings or marketing content you improved



We are especially interested in examples related to short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, real estate, travel, or local service businesses.



3. VACATION RENTAL / OTA EXPERIENCE



Please briefly answer the following:

* Have you worked with Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, Google Vacation Rentals, Guesty, or other vacation rental platforms?

* Have you optimized vacation rental listings before? If yes, what changes did you make?

* What do you look for when trying to improve the performance of a vacation rental listing?

* What process or checklist do you use to make sure a listing is complete, accurate, and attractive to guests?

* How do you think about the differences between Airbnb, Vrbo, direct booking websites, and other OTAs?



4. LISTING OPTIMIZATION CASE STUDY

Please review the following Airbnb listing: 



After reviewing the listing, please provide a concise recommendation for how you would improve it.



Your response should include:

* A brief summary of your overall impression of the listing.

* An optimized listing title. Please provide one title you believe would perform well on Airbnb and briefly explain why.

* A rewritten and optimized version of the listing. Please rewrite the full listing copy, including the main description, property/space details, location information, guest access, and any important notes you believe should be included. The listing should be written to clearly present the property, highlight its most compelling features, and drive conversion to booking.

* Your top 5 recommended improvements. These can relate to copy, photo order, amenities, guest expectations, OTA performance, direct booking potential, or anything else you believe would improve the listing.

* Your approach to listing optimization. Briefly explain the process you would normally use when reviewing and improving a vacation rental listing.



Please keep your response practical and concise. We are looking for clear writing, strong judgment, and an understanding of how to improve vacation rental listing performance.



WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to join a growing hospitality business at an early stage and help build the marketing engine for a multi-market vacation rental platform. You will have the chance to make a direct impact on listing performance, homeowner acquisition, referral partner marketing, and brand growth across several unique vacation rental markets.



We are looking for someone who is thoughtful, organized, creative, and excited to help build something that can scale.

title: Credentialing Specialist
description:
About Handspring Health

Handspring is a virtual mental health clinic for children, young adults, and families. We are dedicated to transforming mental healthcare for families through high-quality, accessible virtual therapy.



About the Role

The Credentialing Analyst will support the day-to-day management of provider credentialing, licensing, payer enrollment, and related operational systems. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, comfortable working with data and trackers, and able to spot gaps, inconsistencies, and next steps across multiple systems.

This is an analytical operations role. The person in this role will not just complete tasks, but will also help maintain clean data, monitor workflow progress, identify blockers, and give the team clear visibility into credentialing status.



Key Responsibilities

Maintain accurate provider credentialing and licensing data across internal trackers, spreadsheets, shared drives, and external systems.

Review provider files for missing, outdated, or inconsistent information.

Track credentialing, licensing, payer enrollment, recredentialing, renewal, and CAQH attestation deadlines.

Update and maintain CAQH profiles, payer portals, NPI records, license documentation, malpractice insurance records, and other provider files.

Prepare, submit, and track credentialing and payer enrollment applications under the direction of the operations team.

Monitor provider status across credentialing workflows and flag delays, blockers, or missing items.

Create and update reports showing credentialing status, upcoming deadlines, outstanding documents, payer enrollment progress, and other key workflow metrics.

Reconcile information across systems to ensure provider records are accurate and consistent.

Support provider onboarding by collecting, reviewing, and organizing required credentialing documents.

Follow up with providers, internal tea
mbers, and external organizations to move credentialing work forward.



What We Are Looking For

3+ years of experience in healthcare credentialing, provider enrollment, licensing, payer operations, healthcare administration, or operations analysis.

Strong spreadsheet skills and comfort maintaining detailed trackers.

Experience working with U.S. healthcare credentialing workflows.

Experience with CAQH ProView strongly preferred.

Experience with payer portals, provider enrollment, NPI records, state licenses, malpractice documentation, and credentialing files preferred.

Strong attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies across documents and systems.

Comfort working independently in a remote environment.

Strong written communication skills.

Ability to manage recurring workflows, deadlines, and follow-ups without repeated reminders.

Ability to handle confidential provider information with professionalism.

Behavioral health, telehealth, therapy, or multi-state provider credentialing experience is a plus.



Systems Experience Preferred

CAQH ProView

NPPES / NPI Registry

Payer portals

Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel

Google Workspace

Credentialing trackers or project management tools

Shared drives and document management systems

EHR or provider management systems



Nice to Have

Experience credentialing therapists, psychologists, social workers, or other behavioral health providers.

Experience with multi-state licensing workflows.

Experience supporting Medicaid, commercial insurance, or payer enrollment processes.

Experience building or maintaining dashboards, trackers, or workflow reports.

Experience working with offshore or distributed U.S.-based healthcare teams.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Credentialing data is accurate, complete, and consistently updated.

The team has clear visibility into provider status, outstanding items, and next steps.

Licensing, CAQH, payer enrollment, and recredentialing deadlines are tracked proactively.

Provider files are organized, audit-ready, and easy to review.

Workflow blockers are identified early and escalated appropriately.

Trackers and reports are reliable enough for the team to use in weekly operations planning.

title: Short-Form Video Editor for TikTok (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
# Short-Form Video Editor for TikTok — Detail-Oriented, Long-Term



**Job Type:** Full-time

**Salary:** $500–650/month (USD), based on ramp-up, plus performance bonuses



## About the role



I run a TikTok content operation producing short-form product videos at volume. I'm looking for a reliable, detail-obsessed editor to take over the production *and* posting side of my pipeline so I can focus on strategy and product research. This is a long-term role with room to grow as output scales.



You will **not** need to come up with ideas or do research — I provide the raw assets and an exact formula. Your job is to execute it consistently and catch mistakes before they go live.



## What you'll do (daily)



- Turn provided reference images into short video clips using **Veo**, with the exact prompt I supply (and a second supplied prompt when a video needs two clips) — no creative prompting required, just careful, consistent execution

- Assemble the resulting clips into finished videos directly inside the TikTok app's native editor (so the content looks native to the platform)

- Add text overlays following an exact format (word-by-word captions, specific font / stroke / position — full SOP provided)

- Add trending native sounds, relevant hashtags, and TikTok's in-app tagging / product tagging as part of each post

- Run each video through a compliance checklist before it's approved — **this is the most important part of the job**

- Publish each approved video to the account using TikTok's native scheduler

- Log performance data into a tracking sheet



Target output is around **30 finished videos per day** once you're fully up to speed. You'll start with a smaller batch during training and scale up steadily as you get faster with the formula.



## You must have



- Hands-on experience editing **and posting** inside the TikTok app (native editor, captions, text, sounds, hashtags, scheduling) — this is non-negotiable, it's where you'll work all day

- Excellent written English — on-screen text must be perfect, with no typos or awkward phrasing

- Sharp attention to detail and the discipline to follow rules exactly, even when it's repetitive

- Reliability and consistent daily availability

- Both a **computer** (for generating clips in Veo) and a **smartphone that runs the TikTok app smoothly** — you'll switch between the two daily — plus a stable internet connection

- Availability across a consistent daily schedule; you can work in your own timezone since posts are scheduled, not published live in the 
nt



## Nice to have



- Experience with TikTok Shop / affiliate or e-commerce content

- Familiarity with AI video tools like Veo or Kling — a plus, not a must, since I supply the exact prompts



## The way I work



There are hard content rules that protect the accounts. Breaking one can get content taken down or the account penalized. I care far more about someone who follows the rules carefully and flags problems than someone who is fast but sloppy. You won't be thrown in the deep end — I provide full step-by-step training and clear written SOPs so you know exactly how I want everything done. There is a **paid trial period** before any long-term commitment so we can both make sure it's a good fit.



## Pay and bonuses



Base pay starts at **$500/month** during the trial and early weeks, rising to **$650/month** once you're consistently producing at full volume with a clean track record. On top of that, there are **performance bonuses** when the accounts hit weekly revenue milestones — when the operation does well, you do well. The full bonus structure is shared once you're onboarded.



## How to apply



Read this carefully — applications that don't follow these steps will be ignored:



1. Start your message with the word **GREENHOUSE** so I know you read the full post.

2. In 2-3 sentences, describe your experience editing video inside the TikTok app and the kind of videos you've made.

3. Answer this: I send you a finished video and tell you to post it, but you notice the on-screen text shows an exact price that I've told you we are never allowed to display. What do you do?

4. (Optional) Link to a sample of short-form video work you've edited.



I read every application that follows these steps and reply to the strong ones quickly.

title: Financial Operations Manager
description:
We’re Hiring: Financial Operations Manager



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Financial Operations Manager to support bookkeeping, reporting, payroll coordination, cash flow tracking, tax coordination, and operational financial analytics across multiple business and personal entities.



This role is ideal for someone who is not just comfortable with numbers, but also systems-minded, AI-first, and able to help leadership stay financially organized across several moving parts. We need someone who can take ownership, think ahead, identify issues before they become problems, and use tools, systems, and AI to make financial operations cleaner and more efficient.



You will work closely with leadership and coordinate with tax consultants, contractors, affiliates, and financial service providers.



## About the Role



You will help manage financial operations across multiple entities, including personal finances, real estate-related businesses, and a growing SaaS company. This includes maintaining accurate records, preparing financial reports, tracking cash flow, coordinating tax documentation, monitoring contractor and affiliate payments, and supporting leadership with financial visibility and decision-making.



This is not a passive bookkeeping role. We are looking for someone who can manage recurring responsibilities, improve financial systems, flag risks early, and recommend better ways to organize, report, and automate finance-related work.



The role serves as the primary financial coordination point between ownership, tax professionals, contractors, affiliates, and financial service providers.



## What You’ll Do



### Bookkeeping & Financial Records



* Maintain bookkeeping and financial records across multiple business and personal entities.

* Keep transactions properly categorized and reconciled.

* Ensure financial records are accurate, organized, and up to date.

* Maintain clean documentation for expenses, income, transfers, contractor payments, affiliate payouts, and business obligations.

* Identify inconsistencies, missing records, or unusual activity and flag them proactively.



### Financial Reporting & Cash Flow



* Prepare monthly financial reports and cash flow updates.

* Monitor cash balances across accounts and flag upcoming funding needs.

* Advise ownership when transfers are needed to cover payroll, taxes, contractor payments, subscriptions, affiliate payouts, and other obligations.

* Support forecasting and financial planning through clear reporting and analysis.

* Help leadership understand what the numbers mean, not just what the numbers are.



### Tax Coordination & Compliance Support



* Coordinate with tax consultants and assist with tax preparation.

* Help organize tax documents, tax organizers, contractor records, and compliance-related files.

* Monitor contractors and affiliates for payment tracking and 1099 compliance.

* Ensure financial documentation is organized and accessible for tax professionals.

* Track recurring tax-related deadlines and follow up before they become urgent.



### Payroll & Contractor Payments



* Process or coordinate payroll for business ownership and tea
mbers where applicable.

* Track contractor and affiliate payouts.

* Review payout approvals and ensure payment information is accurate.

* Maintain records of completed and pending payments.

* Help improve payment tracking systems so there is clear visibility into who has been paid, who is pending, and what requires approval.



### SaaS / Operational Analytics



* Manage Stride CRM user sign-up databases and related financial tracking.

* Monitor user analytics, affiliate performance, and payout approvals.

* Help track revenue, churn, signups, affiliate activity, and related SaaS metrics.

* Support leadership with insights that connect financial data to business performance.

* Identify trends, gaps, or anomalies in business performance data.



### Process Improvement & AI Leverage



* Use AI tools to reduce repetitive manual work and improve reporting speed.

* Use AI to help organize financial data, summarize reports, analyze spreadsheets, create checklists, draft documentation, and identify process gaps.

* Look for recurring finance tasks that can be automated, systemized, or simplified.

* Document repeatable workflows so the finance function becomes easier to manage over time.

* Help turn messy information into clean, usable trackers, reports, and decision-making tools.



### Financial Liaison & Communication



* Serve as the primary financial coordination point between ownership, tax professionals, contractors, affiliates, and financial service providers.

* Communicate clearly when information is missing, deadlines are approaching, or decisions are needed.

* Help keep leadership informed without requiring constant follow-up.

* Ask smart questions when something is unclear instead of guessing.



## What We’re Looking For



### Required



* Strong bookkeeping and financial operations experience.

* Experience preparing financial reports and cash flow updates.

* Comfortable managing financial records across multiple entities or business units.

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

* Clear written communication.

* Highly organized and reliable.

* Able to work independently and follow through without constant supervision.

* Comfortable handling sensitive financial information with discretion.

* Willing to document processes and improve systems over time.

* Proactive enough to flag risks, missing information, or upcoming obligations before being asked.

* Comfortable using AI tools to improve speed, organization, documentation, reporting, and analysis.



### Strongly Preferred



* Experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

* Experience coordinating with tax preparers, accountants, or CPAs.

* Familiarity with payroll, contractor payments, and 1099 tracking.

* Experience supporting entrepreneurs, real estate businesses, SaaS companies, or multi-entity owners.

* Experience with financial dashboards, spreadsheets, and operational reporting.

* Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills.

* Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully and responsibly in financial operations.



### Bonus Points



* Experience with Xero, QuickBooks, Google Sheets, Stripe, payroll tools, or affiliate tracking.

* Experience with real estate, land investing, or SaaS metrics.

* CPA, accounting degree, bookkeeping certification, or tax-related experience.

* Ability to build or improve financial dashboards.

* Experience building SOPs or documentation for finance workflows.

* Experience creating financial trackers, forecasting models, or automated reporting systems.



## Who You Are



You are someone who:



* Takes initiative instead of waiting to be chased.

* Uses AI and automation to reduce repetitive manual work.

* Thinks critically about financial systems, reporting, and process gaps.

* Notices risks early and communicates them clearly.

* Can turn messy information into organized reports, trackers, and next steps.

* Looks for better ways to complete recurring finance tasks.

* Understands that this role is not just bookkeeping, but financial operations support for leadership decision-making.

* Protects sensitive information and handles financial data with care.

* Is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with multiple businesses and priorities.

* Can balance accuracy, speed, and good judgment.



## Success in This Role



In the first 30 days, success would look like understanding the financial structure, current reporting process, recurring obligations, payroll/payment cadence, and key entities involved. You should be able to identify what reports exist, what is missing, what needs cleanup, and what recurring workflows must be protected.



By 60–90 days, we would expect you to own the recurring finance cadence more independently, provide clear monthly reports, flag cash flow needs ahead of time, maintain organized records, support tax coordination, and help improve overall financial visibility across the businesses.



Long term, success means leadership has cleaner visibility into cash flow, reporting, taxes, contractor payments, affiliate payouts, and business performance without constantly having to chase information.



## Compensation & Details



* Remote position

* Part-time or full-time depending on experience and fit

* Long-term opportunity for the right person

* Compensation based on experience, skill level, and communication ability

* Must be available for some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time

* Reports directly to leadership



## How to Apply



We’d love to get to know the person behind the resume, not just look through generic links or a basic application.



Please apply here: 



In the form, we’ll ask for:



1. Your resume

2. A short summary of your bookkeeping / financial operations experience

3. Your expected hourly rate

4. A short Loom video



For the Loom, please keep it around 2–4 minutes and answer:



1. Tell us about the most complex bookkeeping, financial operations, or multi-entity finance role you’ve handled.

2. How do you stay organized when managing finances across multiple entities, people, accounts, or deadlines?

3. What recurring finance tasks do you think should be automated or systemized?



We personally review applications and videos because we’re looking for someone who brings more than bookkeeping experience. We’re looking for someone thoughtful, proactive, organized, and able to bring real financial clarity to the team.

title: Amazon & eBay Marketplace Manager | Product Listing Specialist
description:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Amazon & eBay Marketplace Manager to take full ownership of our product listings and marketplace performance across Amazon Seller Central and eBay Seller Hub.



This role is focused on end-to-end marketplace execution, including product listing creation, optimisation, pricing accuracy, inventory control, and ongoing account health management.



The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience working within Amazon and eBay seller platforms, with a deep understanding of how to structure listings for visibility, compliance, and conversion. This is not a basic upload role. It requires someone who can manage catalogue quality, optimise performance, and maintain operational accuracy across both marketplaces.



You will work closely with internal teams to ensure product data, stock levels, and pricing are consistently accurate and aligned across all systems.



Key Responsibilities

1. Product Listing Management (Amazon & eBay)

• Create, update, and manage product listings across Amazon and eBay

• Ensure all listings are accurate, complete, and professionally structured

• Write and optimise product titles, bullet points, descriptions, and item specifics

• Assign correct categories, attributes, and product classifications

• Upload and manage product images, ensuring correct sequencing for conversion

• Maintain accurate product data including SKUs, barcodes, dimensions, weight, pricing, and delivery details

• Review existing listings and implement improvements to increase visibility and conversion rates

• Identify underperforming listings and execute corrective updates

• Maintain consistency of product data across Amazon, eBay, and internal systems



2. Amazon Seller Central Management

• Create and manage listings within Amazon Seller Central

• Build and maintain parent-child variation structures (size, colour, weight, bundle, etc.)

• Resolve listing issues including suppressed listings, inactive ASINs, and stranded inventory

• Manage product metadata including titles, bullets, descriptions, browse nodes, product IDs, and backend keywords

• Monitor listing health and account performance metrics

• Ensure compliance with Amazon catalogue policies and best practices

• Coordinate with internal teams to align stock availability and fulfilment settings

• Support ongoing optimisation to improve search ranking and conversion performance



3. eBay Seller Hub Management

• Create and manage listings within eBay Seller Hub

• Set up and maintain variation listings accurately

• Ensure all item specifics are fully completed and compliant with eBay requirements

• Manage listing content including titles, descriptions, pricing, images, shipping, and returns

• Monitor listing performance and implement improvements where needed

• Maintain accurate stock levels and availability

• Ensure compliance with eBay listing policies and marketplace standards

• Maintain clean, accurate, and commercially optimised listings



Additional Requirements

The successful candidate must demonstrate:

• Strong attention to detail and data accuracy

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Strong organisational and multitasking skills

• Proactive problem-solving and issue identification

• Clear communication with internal teams



Experience in any of the following will be highly advantageous:

• Amazon flat files and bulk uploads

• eBay listing tools and bulk editing

• Inventory management systems

• Marketplace SEO and conversion optimisation

• Products with variations (size, weight, bundles, multi-SKU structures)

• Experience with physical goods such as fitness, bulky items, or multi-variant catalogues



Working Hours

Flexible working arrangement, with expected overlap during UK business hours for coordination and communication.



How to Apply

Please send your application with the subject line: Amazon & eBay Specialist – [Your Full Name]



Include the following:

• Updated CV or resume

• Brief summary of your Amazon and eBay experience

• Examples of marketplaces, brands, or product categories you have managed



Candidates with proven hands-on experience managing Amazon and eBay marketplaces, particularly those with complex catalog structures and variation-heavy product ranges, will be prioritised.

title: Exucutive Assistant | Full-Time | Sales-Forward Role
description:
About Us

Home Service Callers is a staffing and operations company built around a network of 100+ home service business owners across the United States. Our clients run businesses in cleaning, pressure washing, window washing, landscaping, plumbing, electrical, and more — and they need sharp, hungry people to help them grow.

We don't just place you and disappear. You get a 5-day paid bootcamp, 90 days of guaranteed base salary, daily office hours, and an operations team actively supporting your success from day one.



The Role

This is an executive assistant position with a strong sales component. You won't just be answering
s — you'll be the right hand of a US-based business owner, helping run the day-to-day of their company using our proven systems, tools, and training.

You'll handle inbound and outbound sales calls, customer follow-ups, service scheduling, contractor coordination, review collection, and referral generation. If you've thrived in a sales environment and know how to build relationships over the phone, you'll excel here.



What Your Week Looks Like



Taking inbound calls from potential customers and converting them into booked jobs

Following up with leads, past customers, and prospects

Coordinating with service providers and keeping operations running smoothly

Collecting 5-star reviews and generating referrals

Converting one-time customers into recurring clients

Performance Bonuses — permanent increases to your base:

Monthly Bonus Incentives — stack $200 to $600+ extra per month through:



New deals closed

One-time customers converted to recurring

Referrals brought in

5-star reviews collected



Top performers consistently earn $1,400–$1,600+/month combining base and incentives.



Training & Support



5-day bootcamp — 15 to 20 hours total, fully remote

Covers: business model, sales fundamentals, objection handling, hiring basics, operations, software tools, and the Three R's (Reviews, Referrals, Recurring)

Daily office hours after placement to keep improving

90-day transitional support period — you are never thrown in alone



The highest-performing bootcamp graduates get placed first and start earning immediately.



Requirements



Fluent English — spoken and written, confident on the phone with American customers

Sales background — you've handled calls, built rapport, closed deals, handled objections

Strong time management — you manage your own schedule and hit deadlines without being chased

Reliable internet connection — non-negotiable for a fully remote role

Self-starter mentality — you don't wait to be told what to do



Who Thrives Here

You're hungry. You want a long-term position, not a gig. You've worked in sales or customer-facing roles and you're good on the phone. You want a base that's secure and a commission structure that rewards you directly for what you produce. You're ready to grow alongside a US business owner who needs you.



How to Apply

Submit your application and include a voice recording introducing yourself and describing your sales or customer service background. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.

If you've already applied and haven't heard back — show up to the bootcamp. Your performance there determines everything.



Home Service Callers operates across the United States and places assistants with vetted home service business owners. This is a remote, full-time position open to candidates in Brazil, the Philippines, Lebanon, and Latin America.

title: Influencer & Partnership Development Specialist (Performance-Based, High-Quality Outreach)
description:
We are a licensed real estate company in Japan working with overseas investors.

This is a thinking role focused on outreach and partnerships.



Your job is to identify the RIGHT influencers, brokers, and professionals

and start meaningful conversations that can lead to real business partnerships.



If you rely on copy-paste templates or mass messaging, do NOT apply.



What You Will Do



• Research influencers, brokers, and professionals (US, Singapore, etc.)

• Understand their audience and positioning

• Write personalized outreach messages (Instagram / LinkedIn /
)

• Send only 1 thoughtful follow-up (no spam)

• Track replies and improve message quality



How Performance is Evaluated



We do NOT measure hours.



We evaluate based on:



• Reply rate

• Quality of replies (serious vs low-quality)

• Meaningful conversations started



Trial & Compensation



• 1–2 week paid trial

• Performance-based compensation (no hourly pay)

• Long-term opportunity for high performers



### Compensation Structure (Performance-Based)



This role is fully performance-based.



During both the trial and post-trial period, the same unit-based compensation applies:



• Valid collaboration reply: 500 JPY per reply (approx. 190 PHP)  

• Confirmed meeting booked: 3,000 JPY per meeting (approx. 1,140 PHP)  



 A reply only counts if it shows real interest in collaboration  

 Meeting payment applies only when a call is actually scheduled  



There is no fixed salary or hourly pay.



After the trial period:

• No monthly cap on earnings  

• Compensation increases based on output and quality  

• Additional incentives or bonuses may be added over time for strong performers  



Top performers can generate significant monthly income depending on performance.





 IMPORTANT – DO NOT APPLY IF



• You use copy-paste templates

• You send mass messages without thinking

• You cannot explain your strategy



 REQUIRED TO APPLY (MANDATORY)



To apply, you MUST complete the following task:



 Task: Write a REAL outreach message



Choose ONE of the following:



• A US-based real estate influencer

• A broker with international clients



Then submit:



 Cold DM

 A personalized outreach message (no templates)



 Follow-up message

 Only ONE follow-up



 Strategy explanation

 Why this message would get a reply

 What response you are trying to get



 Target link

 Instagram / LinkedIn / Website of the person you chose



 Applications will be rejected if:



• Messages look generic

• No personalization

• No explanation

• Target is not relevant



After the trial, compensation will be fully performance-based, 

linked to qualified conversations and partnership outcomes.

title: Accounting Operations Lead | Elevated Hospitality Partners
description:
ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS | ACCOUNTING OPERATIONS LEAD



Philippines - Independent Contractor | Full-Time



ABOUT ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS



Elevated Hospitality Partners supports a growing portfolio of short-term rental property management brands across multiple U.S. markets, including Texas, New Mexico, and California, with over 1,000 total properties.



Our companies manage vacation rental homes on behalf of homeowners, with a focus on excellent guest experiences, thoughtful homeowner communication, strong local operations, and disciplined financial management. As we continue to grow, we are building a centralized finance and accounting function that can support our operating companies with consistency, accuracy, and scalability.



We are looking for an experienced Accounting Operations Lead based in the Philippines to help manage our end-to-end accounting workflows across all markets.



This is not a basic bookkeeping role. We are looking for a high-ownership accounting professional who has existing experience in the U.S. short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting space and understands the complexity of homeowner statements, homeowner payouts, vendor payments, tax filing and remittance, property-level accounting, and month-end close across multiple markets.



IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT

- Prior experience supporting a U.S.-based short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality business is required.

- Experience with Guesty is strongly preferred, but not required. Experience with similar property management systems or short-term rental accounting workflows will also be considered.

- CPA certification is preferred.



ROLE OVERVIEW

As the Accounting Operations Lead, you will report to the Chief Financial Officer and be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations across our three short-term rental brands.



You will lead a small team of external and internal bookkeeping and accounting resources. Initially, much of the work will involve managing external bookkeeping and accounting partners, ensuring their work is completed accurately and on time, and taking day-to-day accounting coordination off the CFO’s plate. Over time, this role may help build, train, and lead internal accounting tea
mbers as we bring more accounting processes in-house.



The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple accounting workstreams at once. You should be able to create structure, identify gaps, follow up on open items, and ensure accounting processes are completed accurately and on time.



WORKING HOURS

This is a full-time role aligned to U.S. Central Time. Required schedule: 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time, Monday-Friday.



Central Daylight Time to Philippines Time:

* 9:00am-5:00pm CDT = 10:00pm-6:00am PHT

* Because the Philippines does not observe daylight saving time, the Philippines time equivalent may shift when the U.S. changes between CDT and CST.

* Candidates must be comfortable working overnight Philippines hours on a consistent basis.



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

This is a full-time independent contractor role based in the Philippines.

* Base pay: $1,700-$2,300 USD per month, based on experience.

* Compensation at the higher end of the range will be reserved for candidates with direct U.S. short-term rental accounting experience, Guesty experience, homeowner statement and payout experience, CPA certification, and prior leadership of bookkeeping or accounting resources.

* 13th month pay: Offered in December and prorated for partial years.

* PTO: Accrues at 1 paid day per month, usable after 90 days, with no annual rollover.

* Long-term opportunity: This is intended to be a long-term role with the opportunity to grow into a broader accounting leadership position as we continue building our internal finance and accounting team.



YOU WILL OWN

* Day-to-day accounting operations across Sierra Sol, Third Coast, and Redwood Coast.

* Month-end close coordination across all operating brands.

* Chart of accounts maintenance and accounting structure improvements.

* Homeowner statement review and homeowner payout support.

* Vendor payment workflows and accounts payable coordination.

* Tax filing and remittance support.

* End-to-end accounting flows across property management systems, accounting platforms, banking/payment tools, and reporting processes.

* Coordination and accountability of external and internal bookkeeping resources.

* Accounting SOPs, checklists, calendars, and process documentation.



ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES



ACCOUNTING OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT

* Manage day-to-day accounting workflows across Sierra Sol, Third Coast, and Redwood Coast.

* Coordinate accounting activities across multiple markets, brands, entities, and accounting resources.

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for external and internal bookkeeping resources.

* Ensure accounting tasks are completed accurately, consistently, and on schedule.

* Maintain clear accounting task lists, close calendars, open-item trackers, and follow-up routines.

* Identify process gaps, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve accounting workflows.

* Create structure and accountability across the full accounting process.



MONTH-END CLOSE

* Own and coordinate the month-end close process across all operating brands.

* Maintain the monthly close calendar and ensure deadlines are met.

* Review reconciliations, open items, supporting schedules, and accounting workpapers.

* Coordinate with bookkeeping and accounting resources to resolve missing information or discrepancies.

* Prepare summaries of close status, unresolved issues, and items requiring CFO review.

* Support timely preparation of market-level and company-level financial reporting.

* Help ensure each market’s financials are accurate, consistent, and ready for leadership review.



CHART OF ACCOUNTS AND FINANCIAL STRUCTURE

* Help maintain and improve the chart of accounts across multiple entities and operating brands.

* Ensure transactions are coded consistently across markets.

* Support department, market, homeowner, property, and entity-level reporting needs.

* Help create scalable accounting structures that support business growth.

* Document accounting policies, workflows, coding rules, and reporting standards.

* Identify where account structure, classes, departments, properties, or other reporting dimensions need to be improved.



HOMEOWNER STATEMENTS AND PAYOUTS

* Support the preparation, review, and accuracy of homeowner statements.

* Help ensure homeowner payouts are processed accurately and on time.

* Review homeowner charges, owner proceeds, adjustments, deductions, reimbursements, and management fees.

* Investigate and resolve homeowner accounting questions or discrepancies.

* Ensure property-level revenue, expenses, fees, and reimbursements are properly reflected.

* Help maintain clean and accurate homeowner accounting records.



VENDOR PAYMENTS AND PAYABLES

* Manage and improve the vendor payment process.

* Ensure vendor bills are properly received, coded, approved, and scheduled for payment.

* Coordinate with market teams to resolve missing invoices, approvals, W-9s, or supporting details.

* Support payment tracking, vendor statement review, and payables reporting.

* Help ensure strong controls around vendor payments and expense approvals.

* Identify recurring vendor payment issues and recommend process improvements.



TAX FILING AND REMITTANCE SUPPORT

title: Funnel Builder and Meta ads Specialist
description:
We are a fast-growing marketing agency in high-growth businesses in coaching and consulting. With consistent $100,000 monthly revenue and a Q3 2025 goal of $250,000, we build scalable marketing machines that prioritize performance and measurable outcomes. Our lean, outcome-obsessed team is seeking a hybrid GHL Funnel Builder and Meta Media Buyer to architect funnels and drive high-impact ad campaigns that fuel our clients’ growth.



This role combines expertise in GoHighLevel (GHL) funnel building with advanced Meta advertising skills to drive lead generation and conversions for our $99/month community and $15,000 upsell offer. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, high-output operator who thrives in a high-trust, performance-driven environment, with a knack for building funnels and scaling Meta ad campaigns.



Key Responsibilities:



GHL Funnel Building (50% of Time)



Construct and customize GHL funnels for lead magnets, community sign-ups, and upsell paths using pre-designed templates.

Set up funnel components, including landing pages, opt-in forms, and automations (e.g., lead tagging,
 triggers), adhering to the agency’s launch checklist.



Customize funnel designs (e.g., text, images, videos) based on client needs, ensuring mobile-friendly layouts and seamless user experiences.



Test funnels for functionality (e.g., form submissions, page loading) before launch to ensure quality and performance.



Document funnel setup processes to support team training and maintain consistency.



Meta Media Buying (40% of Time)



Build, manage, and scale performance-driven Meta campaigns across multiple brands (real estate, digital products, services, SaaS).



Develop ad copy, creative briefs, and thumb-stopping hooks that drive high ROAS, CTR, CPL, and LTV.



Test ad angles, lead magnets, videos, UGC, and static creatives at speed, optimizing based on data-driven insights.



Manage tracking, retargeting, and attribution within Meta Ads Manager to ensure accurate performance reporting.







Create growth loops integrating Meta ads with GHL funnels, websites,
, and AI outreach.



Collaboration and Reporting (10% of Time)



Collaborate with content teams, funnel builders, and leadership to align on strategy and vision.



Build and maintain reporting dashboards to track funnel performance and ad metrics, enabling smart decision-making.



Provide weekly progress updates to Agata on funnel setups, ad performance, and any challenges encountered.



Offer feedback on templates and ad strategies to improve efficiency and results.



Required Skills and Experience



GHL Funnel Building:



1+ year of experience with GoHighLevel, including building landing pages, opt-in forms, and basic automations.



Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established processes (e.g., templates, checklists).



Proficiency in managing multiple funnel projects and meeting deadlines.



Meta Media Buying:

- 3+ years managing $20,000+/month in Meta ad spend profitably.

- Deep mastery of Meta Business Suite, Ads Manager, audiences, and tracking.

- Strong knowledge of creative strategy (scripts, ad structures, testing methodologies).

- Expertise in A/B testing, scaling principles, and performance funnels.



General:

- Excellent organizational skills and proficiency in tools like Google Sheets, Google Docs, or similar for task tracking and documentation.

- Reliable internet connection and availability to work remotely (Philippines preferred).



Preferred Skills

- Experience supporting marketing campaigns for coaches/consultants.

- Familiarity with Google Ads or
 marketing platforms (e.g., Active Campaign).

- Prior work in fast-paced, remote team environments.



Why Join Us?

- Work directly with founders and senior operators in a dynamic 8-person agency.

- Own ad accounts and funnels with full trust to perform, no micromanaging.

- Drive real business growth across multiple verticals, contributing to our $250,000 Q3 revenue goal.

- Grow your skills in a supportive, high-performance team with opportunities for bonuses and real upside.

- Work remotely from the Philippines with a proven team delivering exceptional results for coaches and consultants.



To Apply



Submit a 2–3 minute video addressing:

1. Your best-performing Meta campaign (what made it work?).

2. Your unique approach to building and scaling GHL funnels and Meta ads. 

3. Why you’re the hybrid GHL and Meta expert we’ve been looking for.

title: Administration & Workflow Coordinator (Permassist)

Key Responsibilities:

Process files through multiple workflow stages within cloud-based software platforms.

Manage and maintain digital records using Permassist and associated systems.

Ensure all documentation is correctly uploaded, categorised, and stored.

Monitor workflow progress and ensure tasks move through required approval stages.

Maintain accurate records of communications, approvals, and completed tasks.

> Systems Administration

Work within Permassist and other cloud-based workflow management systems.

Learn and follow software-specific workflows and approval processes.

Maintain data integrity across multiple platforms.

Ensure all information entered into systems is accurate and up to date.



> Required Skills & Experience

Previous experience in administration, document control, compliance administration, or workflow coordination.

Experience using Permassist management software.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Experience working with cloud-based software platforms and digital file management systems.

Ability to follow structured processes and workflows consistently.

Excellent organisational and time management skills.

Strong written communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple files and deadlines simultaneously.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace.



> Preferred Experience

Background in compliance, consulting, legal administration, HR, industrial relations, or government-related administration.

Experience handling approvals, forms, and document generation processes.

Familiarity with Fair Work administration or compliance-related environments.

title: Video Editor — Luxury Wedding Content | CapCut | Fast Turnaround (3–4 Videos/Day)
description:

This is a high-volume role — you'll be producing 3–4 polished videos per day — so speed, consistency, and a strong eye for luxury aesthetics are essential. We work globally, so you'll coordinate across US, Europe, and Dubai time zones.

- Edit 3–4 cinematic videos daily from mixed photo + video assets

- Produce short-form reels (Instagram, TikTok) and long-form YouTube content

- Build portfolio films and "best of" highlight reels with strong hooks and seamless transitions

- Beat-sync edits to music with smooth, elegant transitions

- Color-grade to a luxury editorial standard (clean, true-to-life skin tones)

- Maintain a consistent premium aesthetic across all deliverables

- Hit tight daily turnaround times without sacrificing quality



Must-Have Skills:



- Expert in CapCut (this is our primary editing tool)

- Strong color grading skills — cinematic, elegant, not over-processed

- A genuine eye for luxury/editorial aesthetics

- Proven ability to work at high volume without dropping quality

- Comfortable working across global time zones and meeting daily deadlines

- Strong English communication and reliability



Nice to Have:



- Experience editing wedding or luxury lifestyle content

- YouTube editing experience (pacing, retention, thumbnails a plus)

- Photo retouching 

- Familiarity with trending Reel/Shorts formats and sound design

title: Outbound Setter — Canadian Healthcare SaaS | Full-Time | $7/hr + $50/Zoom + $250/Sale
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

DoctorFlow is a healthcare technology company in Windsor, Ontario, Canada. Our founder, Dr. Bart Kaczmarek, is a practicing family physician who built a system that helps busy clinics see more patients without adding staff. It's now installed in 6 clinics across Ontario, growing through word-of-mouth.

We are not a call center or agency. We are founder-led product company. You report directly to the founder.



THE ROLE

You are our first outbound setter. Your single job: book 15-minute Zoom demos onto the founder's calendar. You will work from 500+ pre-researched Canadian clinic leads. Long-term role with a clear path to senior position within 12 months.



DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

- 40–60 outbound calls per day from our lead list

- Get past gatekeepers; book Zoom demos with clinic managers

- Send pre-written follow-up
s within 30 minutes of each call

- Log every call outcome

- Run our 14-day follow-up sequence (calls +
s)

- 20-minute daily Slack/Zoom huddle



PAY

- $7 USD/hour, full-time (40 hrs/week), weekly via PayPal

- $50 USD per Zoom demo booked AND attended

- $250 USD per signed clinic (paid 30 days after install)

- Productive setters earn $2,500–3,000 USD/month consistently.



HOURS

- Mon–Fri, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time = 8:00 PM – 4:00 AM Manila time.

- This is a graveyard shift. If you cannot commit to the hours long-term, do not apply.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

- No data entry, admin, social media, or general VA tasks

- No working for other employers on the side — dedicated, exclusive role

- No cold pitching patients — B2B only (clinic managers and owners)



REQUIRED

- Minimum 3 years outbound B2B cold calling — real cold dialing to businesses, not appointment-setting or lead-gen forms

- Strong, neutral, easily-understood English (clinic managers will be skeptical; thick accents will not work)

- Experience with North American businesses

- Quiet workspace, reliable internet, clear-mic headset

- Comfort with rejection — 30 "no"s a day is normal

- Self-discipline without supervision



PREFERRED

- SaaS or tech sales background

- Healthcare/medical office experience

- HubSpot, Google Calendar, Slack

- Sales background (not customer service)



HOW TO APPLY

Applications missing any of the below will be rejected without review:

1. 150-word intro — why you're right for this role

2. 90-second voice recording reading this script aloud:

"Hi, this is [your name] calling from Dr. Kaczmarek's office in Windsor, Ontario. I'm reaching out because Dr. Kaczmarek is a family physician who built a system that's helping busy clinics make about thirty-five thousand dollars more per doctor per year by better coordinating their staff and rooms. He's currently adding a few clinics in the area at a early partner rate. Would the clinic manager be available for a quick 30-second conversation?" 

3. Outbound B2B experience. For each role:

- Company name

- Your title and dates (month/year)

- What product or service you were calling about

 -Average calls per day and what you were measured on (meetings booked, deals closed, etc.)

4. Confirm hours availability (Mon–Fri, 8AM–4PM ET)

5. One sentence: What's the difference between a "no" and a "not yet" in sales?



TIMELINE

- Applications close in 10 days

- Top 5 candidates get a 30-minute Zoom interview with the founder

- Hire starts within 1 week of interview

- Two-week paid trial at full base + bonuses



We're not in a rush. We'll wait for the right hire.

title: Phone Sales & Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
Time for Tutoring is a Sydney-based tutoring agency that connects Muslim families with qualified tutors. Our brand is built around and trusted by the Muslim community. The vast majority of our customers are Muslim families, and cultural understanding is at the heart of how we operate.

We are looking for someone to handle inbound enquiries, onboard new customers, and maintain ongoing relationships with families over the phone as we scale. We are a business that works 7 days a week and customer outreach is also completed on weekends.



What you'll be doing:



Speaking with warm leads who have already expressed interest in our service and guiding them through to becoming a customer

Calling parents first to gather key information so our team can match them with the right tutor

Explaining our service and pricing clearly and confidently

Handling objections with skill and composure. Parents will push back on price, ask hard questions, and need convincing. Your ability to handle this naturally and without being pushy is one of the most important parts of this role

Being the main point of contact for families after onboarding, maintaining the relationship, checking in, and resolving any concerns that come up

Following up with leads who have not yet committed

Light admin to keep things organised



Who we're looking for:



Excellent spoken English. This is a phone-heavy role with Australian customers and how you come across on a call is everything

A genuine understanding of Islamic culture, Muslim family life, and Muslim values. You do not just know about it, you get it

Warm, confident, and natural on the phone

Proven ability to handle objections and close without being pushy

Someone who builds trust easily and can maintain long term relationships with families

Previous sales, customer service, or phone-based experience required

A requirement of the role is to have a flexible availability as call volume varies day to day. A responsive and reachable individual is needed for this role. The nature of the role involves frequent communications with the team at various times within reason.



This role is not the right fit if you are not familiar with Muslim culture and the expectations of Muslim families.

To apply you must include:



A 60-second voice recording where you introduce yourself and then respond to this scenario: "A parent calls and asks if we can guarantee results. What do you say?"

A brief description of any phone-based or sales experience you have

Answer this question: How familiar are you with Islamic culture and Muslim communities, and where does that familiarity come from?



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered. Please do not read an ai scripted response. We appreciate genuine human responses.



This is a part-time role with flexible hours. Pay is a base rate of $5 to $10 AUD per hour plus commission per successful onboarding. The more you convert, the more you earn. There is real room to grow with the business as we scale.

If you have read this job listing in full, write the word SYDNEY at the very top of your application.

Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like):



Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs

Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA

Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA

High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications

Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents

Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings



Key Responsibilities:

1) Board & Governance Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings.

Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required.

Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements.

2) Owner & Resident Relations

Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via
, phone, and portal.

Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders).

Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs.

3) Financial Coordination & Reporting 

Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy.

Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies.

Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment.

4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA)

Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections.

Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records.

Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews.

Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents).

5) Information Management & Systems

Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations.

Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules.

Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository.

6) Team Leadership & Development

Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards.

Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings

Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority)

Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected

Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time

Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time

Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate

Qualifications:

3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience

Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management

Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail

Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

title: AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor for TikTok/Reels Ads
description:
We are building **Kreo AI**, a new AI image and video generation mobile app.



Kreo AI helps users create AI videos, AI images, photo-to-video effects, AI dance videos, image edits, and viral social media content.



We are looking for a creative **AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor** who can generate high-quality AI image/video assets and turn them into jaw-dropping short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Meta ads, and TikTok ads.



This is not a general VA role. This role is focused on **AI content creation, short-form editing, and ad creative production**.



## Main Goal of the Role



Your main job is to create high-quality short-form video creatives using AI-generated assets.



You should be able to:



1. Generate AI images/videos using AI tools

2. Create strong visual concepts

3. Edit the assets into TikTok/Reels-style videos

4. Add hooks, captions, text overlays, music, and CTA

5. Create multiple creative variations for testing



We want videos that feel viral, modern, fast-paced, and suitable for TikTok/Reels/Meta ads.



## Responsibilities



### 1. AI Image & Video Asset Creation



You will create AI-generated assets for Kreo AI content and ads.



Examples:



* AI photo-to-video transformations

* AI dance/motion effects

* Cinematic AI videos

* AI portrait transformations

* AI image edits

* Before/after transformation assets

* App-style result demos

* Viral AI effect examples

* AI-generated visuals for ad creatives



Preferred AI tools:



* Kling

* Runway

* Seadance

* Google Veo

* Higgsfield

* ChatGPT / Claude for prompts



You do not need to know every tool, but you should be comfortable learning and testing AI tools quickly.



---



### 2. Short-Form Video Editing



You will turn AI assets into high-quality 9:16 videos for:



* TikTok

* Instagram Reels

* YouTube Shorts

* Meta Ads

* TikTok Ads



Editing should include:



* strong hook in the first 1–2 seconds

* fast pacing

* before/after reveal

* text overlays

* captions

* clean transitions

* music/sound effects

* result-first edits

* CTA ending

* mobile-first format



---



### 3. Ad Creative Production



You will create ad-style videos that can be tested on Meta and TikTok.



Example ad concepts:



* “One photo became this AI video”

* “AI turned my selfie into a movie scene”

* “Upload photo ? choose effect ? get result”

* “AI made my photo dance”

* “This is what AI can do with one image”

* “Create AI photos and turn them into videos”



The videos should be clear, exciting, and easy to understand even without sound.



---



### 4. Creative Variations



You will create multiple versions of the same concept for testing.



For example:



* different hooks

* different first 2 seconds

* different captions

* different thumbnail/cover text

* different CTA

* different music/sound

* different pacing

* different AI result examples



We are not looking for one single video only. We need someone who can create many testable creative variations.



---



### 5. Reference-Based Editing



We may provide reference videos or competitor ad examples.



Your job is to understand the structure and create an original Kreo version.



Important: We do not want to copy other brands exactly. We want to use inspiration and create original content for Kreo AI.



---



## Required Skills



* Strong short-form video editing skills

* Experience editing TikTok/Reels/Shorts

* Experience with CapCut or similar editing tools

* Good sense of pacing, hooks, and retention

* Ability to create before/after transformation videos

* Ability to add clean text overlays and captions

* Ability to create ad-style videos

* Ability to follow creative references

* Ability to generate or work with AI image/video assets

* Good communication

* Organized file delivery

* Ability to meet deadlines



---



## Nice-to-Have Skills



* Experience with AI video tools like Kling, Runway, Seadance, Veo, or Higgsfield

* Experience with AI image tools like Midjourney, DALL·E, or Leonardo

* Experience creating Meta ads or TikTok ads

* Experience with UGC-style ad creatives

* Experience promoting apps or SaaS products

* Experience with Premiere Pro / After Effects

* Experience writing hooks and captions

* Experience researching competitor ads



---



## Tools



Preferred tools:



* CapCut

* Canva

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* After Effects

* Photoshop

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Notion



AI tools that are useful:



* Kling

* Runway

* Google Veo

* Higgsfield

* Seadance

* ChatGPT

* Claude



---



## Work Arrangement



This can start as a paid trial or part-time role.



If the quality is strong, this can become a long-term role.



Please include your expected rate for:



1. Part-time monthly work (4-5 hours/Day)

2. Full-time monthly work (8 hours/Day)



---



## Paid Trial Task



Before hiring long term, selected candidates will complete a paid trial.



For the trial, we will provide:



* one reference video format

* one AI photo/video concept

* basic brand direction for Kreo AI



Your task:



1. Create one 10–15 second vertical ad creative

2. Generate or prepare the AI visual/video asset

3. Add a strong hook in the first 1–2 seconds

4. Use fast pacing and clean captions

5. Show before/after or result reveal clearly

6. Add a CTA at the end

7. Provide 3 alternative hook options

8. Provide 3 thumbnail/cover text options

9. Explain which tools you used



The final video should feel suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads.



---



## Example Creative Direction



Example concept:



**Normal photo ? AI cinematic video transformation**



Possible structure:



1. Show final AI result first for 1 second

2. Show original photo

3. Show “AI generating” or quick transition

4. Reveal the AI video result

5. Add CTA: “Try Kreo AI” / “Join early access”



---



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* creative

* fast

* detail-oriented

* strong at short-form editing

* interested in AI content

* able to create high-quality visual results

* comfortable experimenting with AI tools

* able to create multiple ad variations

* able to follow instructions and improve based on feedback



We are not looking for basic admin support. We are looking for someone who can help create high-quality AI video ads and viral short-form content.



---



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio link

2. 3 best short-form videos you edited

3. Any AI-generated videos/images you created

4. Any ad creatives you edited

5. Tools you use for AI generation and editing

6. Your expected rate per video

7. Your expected monthly rate for part-time work

8. Your expected monthly rate for full-time work

9. Answer this question:



“If you were creating an ad for an AI photo-to-video app, how would you structure the first 5 seconds?”



Applications without portfolio or sample videos may not be considered.
