title: Personal Research & Executive Support Assistant
description:
## Overview



I'm a busy professional and father based in Portugal. I need a sharp, AI-powered research assistant who can take a brief and come back with organized, actionable options.



This is not a virtual receptionist role. This is research, sourcing, coordination, and organization across personal life projects — property renovation, education planning, health, travel, and more.



## AI Is Central to This Role



I use AI extensively and I expect you to as well — ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, or whatever makes you fastest. The best person for this role is someone who already uses AI tools daily and understands how to get great results from them.



**What great looks like:**

- You use AI to find leads faster, compare options, and draft clear summaries

- You know which tool works best for which task

- You verify everything AI gives you — every link works, every supplier is real, every price is current

- Your output is AI-accelerated but human-verified. Speed AND accuracy



The difference between good and great in this role is judgment. AI can find 50 results in seconds. Your job is to verify the best 5 and present them clearly.



In your application, tell me which AI tools you use and how they fit into your workflow. I'm genuinely interested in how you work.



## What You'll Actually Do



**Research & Sourcing (Primary — ~60% of time)**

- Product sourcing: building materials, tiles, fixtures, equipment, furniture — find suppliers, compare pricing, compile options with photos and links

- Service provider research: find specialists, coaches, practitioners across multiple domains. Compile profiles, availability, pricing, contact details

- Education research: homeschooling resources, curricula, programs, activities for a young child

- Travel logistics: flights, accommodation, itineraries, visa requirements

- Health & wellness: research practitioners, equipment, suppliers (natural/holistic focus)

- General: anything I need investigated, compared, or compiled



**Organization & Coordination (~25% of time)**

- Maintain organized research files and shared documents

- Follow up with vendors/contacts on my behalf (English-language)

- Schedule coordination (not calendar management — more like "find 3 available slots with this person")

- Track project progress and outstanding items

- Compile weekly summary of open tasks and findings



**Ad-Hoc Support (~15% of time)**

- Surprise tasks that don't fit a category

- "Can you find out..." questions that need digging

- Price monitoring on specific items

- Booking confirmations, reservation management





## What I'm Looking For



**Must have:**

- Excellent English (written and spoken)

- Daily AI user — you already use AI tools as part of your workflow, not experimenting with them

- Strong research skills — you know how to dig deep, cross-reference, and verify

- Self-directed. I give you a brief, you come back with results. You don't wait for step-by-step instructions

- Organized. Your output is clean — tables, links, photos, pricing, contact details. Not a wall of text

- Reliable. You hit deadlines. If something is going to be late, you tell me before it's due, not after

- Available during European morning hours (CET/WEST — Portugal is GMT+0/+1). Core overlap needed: 08:00-12:00 Lisbon time

- Comfortable working independently

- Meetings will happen daily at the beginning to share context and get started.



**Nice to have:**

- Experience supporting someone in a personal (non-corporate) capacity

- Familiarity with European suppliers and shipping

- Interest in health, wellness, natural living, or property renovation (you'll be researching these constantly)

- Basic Portuguese or Spanish (helpful for reading supplier websites, not required)



**Personality fit:**

- High agency. You see a problem, you solve it. You don't flag it and wait

- Low drama. Professional, clear communication

- Hungry. You take pride in delivering excellent work, not just completing tasks

- Honest. If you can't find something, say so. Don't pad results to look productive



## Hours & Compensation



- **Full-time: 40 hours/week** (Monday-Friday)

- **Schedule:** work your own hours but core overlap 08:00-12:00 Lisbon time required

- **Rate:** Competitive for experience level — please include your expected monthly rate

- **Tools:** Google Workspace, AI tools, messaging app (Slack/Signal/whatsapp), task management tool (Notion)

- **Payment:** Bi-weekly, via Wise or equivalent



## How to Apply



**Step 1:** Send me a brief message covering: (please create a loom video addressing me by name)

1. Your relevant experience (keep it to 3-4 sentences)

2. Why this role appeals to you specifically

3. Which AI tools you use daily and how they fit into your research workflow (be specific)

4. Your expected monthly rate for full-time (40 hours/week)



---



*I respond to every serious application. If you put in the effort on the test task, you'll hear back within 48 hours.*

title: Real Estate Acquisitions - Closer - Land - Remote - USD
description:
ABOUT US



Synergy Land Partners is a growing U.S.-based company that buys vacant land directly from owners across the United States. We're not a giant call center — we're a tight, modern team that values working smart over grinding hard, takes care of its people, and uses the best tools available to make everyone more productive in their role. We're building a company we intend to be a great long-term home.



SLP already has a strong cold outreach team generating a steady, consistent flow of qualified seller leads every week, plus a large backlog of existing leads waiting for the right person. We don't have a shortage of opportunity. We have a need for the right closer to capitalize on it.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



Leads come to you already qualified by our outreach team. Your job is to build the relationship and bring the deal home:



• Call pre-qualified seller leads and build genuine rapport and trust with U.S. landowners over the phone

• Evaluate and comp properties using dedicated land software to understand what a parcel is worth and what purchase price meets the company objectives

• Present offers and negotiate purchase agreements using a consultative, two (and often more) call close approach. You're a trusted guide helping sellers make a decision that meets their goals, not a pushy salesperson

• Relentlessly follow up — many of our best deals take weeks or months of patient nurturing before they close. The closer who follows up wins the deal.

• Manage your pipeline in Follow Up Boss with disciplined stages and follow-up cadences

• Own your numbers — track your activity and conversions, and review your pipeline weekly





WHO YOU ARE



• Fluent, natural English — you can hold an easy, confident, rapport-building conversation with a U.S. landowner. This is non-negotiable.

• A proven closer — you know how to handle rejection, work objections, build trust, and ask for the deal over the phone

• Real estate or land experience is a strong plus, but we'll train the right person on land specifics. Sales skill, willingness to learn, and drive matter most.

• Organized and CRM-disciplined — comfortable managing a pipeline (we use Follow Up Boss) without anyone chasing you

• Self-motivated and competitive — you are driven and confident that your consistent hard work will bring results and financial upside for you and the company

• Long-term minded — you want to grow with a company, not fill a six-month gap





WHO THIS IS FOR



• Closers who've crushed it in phone-based sales (real estate, insurance, solar, high-ticket)

• People who want to own their income, not wait for someone to hand it to them

• Self-starters who thrive without constant check-ins

• People hungry for uncapped earning potential who want to grow





WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



• People looking for a "chill" remote job with guaranteed income and low expectations

• People easily discouraged by rejection

• People who can't self-manage their time or pipeline

• People who need constant hand-holding





COMPENSATION



• Base Salary: $1,500/month USD — paid regardless of closings, so you have stability through the longer land sales cycles

• Commission (uncapped): 1% of gross profit on the first $20,000 of gross profit per closed deal, and 2% of gross profit on everything above $20,000. The bigger the deal you negotiate, the more you earn per dollar. (Gross profit = our sale price minus our purchase price. A $20,000-profit deal pays $200; a $40,000-profit deal pays $600.)

• Realistic On-Target Earnings: $2,000–$2,500+/month TOTAL, with real upside as you close more deals and negotiate larger spreads.



This structure is designed to make a serious, capable closer very well rewarded. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this isn't the fit. If you are confident in your ability to close deals, the upside is real.





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, please send:



1. A short video recording (2-3 minutes) — introduce yourself and briefly describe your sales/closing experience. For the second half, pretend you're opening a call with a U.S. landowner who owns a vacant parcel and explain how you would approach the first conversation with the lead. Provide the link to your video recording with your application. Applications without a recording will not be considered.



2. Your resume / CV

title: Operations & Project Manager (Fast Growing)
description:
Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company

Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. 



This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal.



What You Get If You Win Here

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before. 

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!

If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: 

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. 

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding 

I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. 



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. 



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example 

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership. 



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level. 

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.  



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based  (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no rando
etings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to. 

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit. 



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test)

Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)



If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.

If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.”

title: Video Editor — Long-Term Position (E-commerce brand / Facebook Ads)
description:
We’re a fast-growing DTC brand in the women’s wellness space, operating in the European market. We run paid social as our primary growth channel and we’re scaling — which means we need someone serious on the editing side who can keep up, think with us, and grow into the brand long-term.



This isn’t a one-off gig. We’re looking for someone who wants to immerse themselves in what we do — understand our customer, our product, our angles — and become part of the team. If we grow, you grow with us. Raises, bigger bonuses, more responsibility over time.



What you’ll be doing



• Editing performance ads for Meta (UGC-style, talking-head, static video, and mixed formats)

• Working from concepts and scripts we provide — sometimes pure translation of a proven winner into a new variant, sometimes building from scratch off a brief

• Sourcing your own B-roll, stock footage, and reference clips that match the script and angle

• Researching competitor ads (we’ll point you at a starting list) and pulling visual references that fit

• Using AI tools heavily in your workflow — voiceovers, AI actors, generative B-roll, captions, upscaling

• Adding captions, motion graphics, sound design, hooks, pattern interrupts — the full performance ad toolkit

• Delivering edits ready to upload (correct aspect ratios, safe zones, Meta file specs)



Basic marketing understanding we need from you

You don’t need to be a media buyer, but you do need to understand the fundamentals — because a good edit starts with understanding who we’re talking to and why. We’ll brief you fully on:



• Our target customer (who she is, what she struggles with, what she wants)

• What our product does and the angles we lead with

• The hook, the promise, and the emotional beat each ad is supposed to land



Your job is to internalize all of that and edit toward it — not just cut clips together. If you understand the avatar, the rest of the editing decisions become obvious.



Must be strong with AI

This is non-negotiable. You should already be using tools like:



• Kling, Higgsfield, VEO, Sora — for generative B-roll and shots that don’t exist in stock

• HeyGen, Arcads — for AI actors / UGC-style talking heads

• ElevenLabs or similar for voiceovers

• Captioning + upscaling tools



If you don’t already work with these daily, this role isn’t for you. We move fast and AI is how we keep up.



What we need from you (the person)



• Proactive. We don’t want to chase. If a script is unclear, you ask. If you see a better angle, you suggest it. If B-roll doesn’t exist, you find it or generate it

• You think along with us. You understand what the script is trying to do and edit toward that

• Sharp eye. Pacing, music choice, captions, hook strength — all tight

• Reliable turnaround and clear communication

• You want to manifest in our brand long-term, not jump to the next gig in three months

• Comfortable working in English



What to include in your application



• Which brands have you edited for? Names, niches, links

• How much ad spend have your edits been behind? Rough numbers are fine — we just need to know if you’ve worked on small accounts or scaled accounts

• What’s your hit rate? Out of the ads you’ve made, how many became winners or scaled?

• 3–5 of your best performance ad edits (links, not files)

• Ideally at least one example in a similar niche — wellness, supplements, health, beauty, women’s products

• Which AI tools you use daily and how you use them in your workflow

• Start your application with the word “LAVENDER” so we know you read the full post



Compensation



• Performance bonuses when your ads scale and spend meaningful budget — the more your edits spend, the more you make. Bonus structure explained on the call

• Long-term. If you’re good, this becomes consistent weekly work with raises as we grow together



How to apply

Send your portfolio + the answers to the questions above. Generic applications get ignored — we’re hiring one person, not running a casting call.

title: E-commerce Operations Assistant for Growing U.S. Online Store
description:
Hi!



I’m looking for a reliable full-time E-commerce Operations Assistant to help with daily operations for a growing online store in the U.S. market.



The business is expanding, and I need someone hands-on who can help with customer communication, supplier follow-ups, product research, pricing checks, Shopify tasks, and keeping operations organized.



We sell high-ticket products, not a simple one-product dropshipping item. We work with multiple brands and suppliers, and each brand can have different prices, margins, shipping rules, product details, lead times, warranties, and return policies.



Many products are shipped directly from suppliers or manufacturers, so attention to detail is very important.



This is a full-time position, and it is not a “work whenever you want” role. Since this position involves customer
s, SMS, calls, supplier follow-ups, abandoned checkout follow-ups, and order updates, you must be available during agreed U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time.



The first week will focus on training, onboarding, and learning how our process works. We may use Zoom calls, Google Meet calls, training videos, SOPs, and examples to explain tasks clearly. You are encouraged to ask questions when something is unclear. I prefer someone who asks before guessing, especially when dealing with customers, suppliers, pricing, shipping, or order issues.



As the business grows and you prove you are reliable, responsibilities can increase and pay can also increase based on performance.



Main tasks may include:



Responding to customer
s, SMS, and calls in English, including order updates, product questions, quote follow-ups, abandoned checkout follow-ups, and general customer support.



Making and answering customer calls in English when needed.



Following up with customers by call, SMS, or
 for quotes, pending payments, abandoned checkouts, product questions, delivery updates, and order issues.



Following up with suppliers about stock, pricing, shipping, product details, and lead times.



Updating customers about order status, delivery updates, and supplier responses.



Checking product prices, supplier costs, margins, and competitor pricing.



Comparing our prices with U.S. competitors.



Using a VPN when needed to view U.S. pricing, competitor websites, and product availability.



Helping with Shopify product uploads and product updates.



Reviewing product pages for missing or incorrect information.



Keeping CRM sheets and internal spreadsheets organized.



Updating customer notes, supplier notes, order notes, and follow-up status.



Helping with warranty, return, cancellation, and delivery communication.



Handling customer problems professionally and knowing when to escalate an issue before making promises or decisions.



Following SOPs and training videos for each task.



You will not be expected to know everything on day one. I will assign specific tasks and provide instructions, examples, and training videos when needed.



Requirements



Please do not apply if you do not think you qualify.



Advanced written and spoken English for U.S. customer communication.



Confident speaking with U.S. customers by phone in clear, professional English.



Please only apply if you are comfortable handling conversations in English with U.S. customers, including questions, follow-ups, problems, delays, delivery concerns, warranty issues, and customer complaints.



Spoken English will be verified through a short Zoom, Google Meet, or similar video call during the hiring process.



Comfortable answering calls, making follow-up calls, replying to SMS, and handling customer issues professionally.



Able to communicate clearly when there is a problem, delay, warranty issue, delivery concern, or customer complaint.



Experience with Shopify, e-commerce operations, customer support, or virtual assistant work.



Experience using Google Sheets, CRM sheets, spreadsheets, or similar tools to stay organized.



Able to work with the U.S. market and U.S. customers.



Available full-time during agreed U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time, for customer calls, SMS,
s, supplier follow-ups, Shopify tasks, and order updates.



Must have reliable internet.



Must be able to use a VPN when needed.



Strong attention to detail.



Organized and able to keep accurate notes.



Able to follow step-by-step instructions carefully.



Comfortable checking supplier websites, product pages, pricing, shipping details, and competitor pages.



Able to ask questions when something is unclear instead of guessing.



Able to work with urgency when a task is assigned.



Must understand that refunds, cancellations, discounts, returns, or compensation cannot be approved without owner approval.



Experience using Slack or similar communication tools is a plus, but not required.



Important



This business sells high-ticket products, so mistakes can be expensive. A wrong product detail, wrong price, missed follow-up, or incorrect promise to a customer can create serious problems.



You should not promise customers exact delivery dates unless they are confirmed. You should not approve refunds, returns, cancellations, discounts, or compensation unless I specifically authorize it.



You must be careful when checking prices because different brands have different margins, supplier costs, shipping fees, MAP rules, and competitor pricing.



Examples of tasks you may receive



“Check if this product is in stock with the supplier and confirm the shipping cost.”



“Reply to this customer asking for a delivery update.”



“Call this customer and confirm their shipping address.”



“Call or text this customer who started checkout but did not complete the order.”



“Follow up with this lead and ask if they have any questions before purchasing.”



“Compare our price with this competitor and calculate the margin.”



“Update the CRM sheet with the customer status and next follow-up.”



“Check this Shopify order/customer profile and update the CRM sheet with the latest status.”



“Check if this product page is missing warranty, shipping, or specification details.”



“Upload these products to Shopify using this supplier page.”



“Organize this supplier information in the supplier database.”



“Follow up with this supplier about tracking or freight delivery.”



“Review this customer issue and prepare a draft response.”



How to apply



Please message me here if you are interested.



To show that you read the full post carefully, start your message with:



“Hi Chris, I can help with U.S. e-commerce operations.”



Also, somewhere in your application, mention:



“CRM sheet”



Please do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, answer these questions in your own words:



Have you worked with Shopify, customer service, or e-commerce operations before? Explain briefly.

Are you comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone in English?

Are you available full-time during U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time, for assigned tasks, calls, SMS,
s, and follow-ups?

Have you used Google Sheets, CRM sheets, or spreadsheets to manage customer/order information?

Have you used Slack or similar communication tools before?

A customer asks for an exact delivery date, but the supplier only gave an estimated transit time. How would you respond?

Before telling a customer that a product is in stock, what would you check?

If a customer asks for a refund, discount, cancellation, or compensation, what would you do before confirming anything?

Are you able to use a VPN to check U.S. competitor pricing and product availability?

Are you willing to do a short Zoom or Google Meet call so we can verify your spoken English and communication skills?



If you have any questions before applying, feel free to include them in your message. I will be reviewing applications and answering questions through the chat.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



Thanks!



Chris

title: YouTube Video Editor — Military Content
description:
We produce long-form YouTube videos covering military operations, logistics, history, and the behind-the-scenes details most people never think to ask about. Our videos blend archival footage, AI-generated visuals and voiceover, and custom maps and animations. We're looking for a versatile editor who can move across all of those and turn out engaging, retention-driven videos.

What you'll do



Edit 10–30 minute videos that keep viewers locked in from the cold open to the final frame

Work fluidly across three visual layers: restored/archival footage, AI-generated imagery and voiceover, and motion graphics (maps, troop movements, stat cards, equipment breakdowns, timelines)

Pace edits for retention: tight hooks, clean cuts, 
ntum that never sags

Source and integrate archival footage, stock, and imagery with attention to usage rights

Add captions/subtitles throughout

Layer music and sound design that builds atmosphere without burying narration

Hit a consistent recurring upload schedule



AI tools you'll use (tell us which you know)



Voiceover & audio: ElevenLabs, Descript, or similar

Footage restoration/upscaling: Topaz Video AI or similar

Generated visuals/B-roll: Runway, Kling, Sora, Midjourney, or similar

Captions & rough cuts: CapCut, Opus Clip, Descript



We don't expect mastery of every tool — we want to know where you're strong and where you lean on AI vs. doing it by hand.

What we're looking for



Proven long-form YouTube editing experience (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar — please specify)

Hands-on AI workflow experience — name the tools and how you actually use them

A real instinct for storytelling and retention, not just technical cutting

Comfort blending real archival footage with AI-generated material so the seams don't show

Reliable communicator who turns around revisions quickly



Nice to have



Interest in or knowledge of military history/operations

Strong motion graphics / map animation skills

Thumbnail or title input



To apply: Send your portfolio or 2–3 relevant long-form samples, the editing and AI tools you use (and how), your typical turnaround per video, and your rate. Bonus: include one sample where you blended archival and AI-generated footage.

title: TikTok Content Strategist & Video Editor (Fitness / Weight Loss Niche)
description:
About Me

I'm a fitness creator focused on realistic fat loss, sustainable habits, mindset, calorie awareness, and long-term weight loss. My audience is primarily women looking to lose weight without extreme diets, unrealistic workout plans, or quick-fix solutions.

I'm looking for a highly skilled TikTok strategist and video editor who understands retention, hooks, storytelling, audience psychology, and short-form content growth. My goal is not just to make videos look better, but to improve watch time, engagement, profile visits, followers, and overall account growth.

What I'm Looking For

I need someone who can help identify why videos perform well or poorly and make strategic recommendations to improve future content.

I'm not looking for someone who only edits videos. I'm looking for someone who can think strategically, improve content packaging, strengthen hooks, increase retention, and help build a scalable content system.

Responsibilities

Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts

Improve pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention

Create engaging captions and on-screen text

Recommend stronger hooks and opening sequences

Create multiple hook variations for testing

Add captions, graphics, zooms, B-roll, transitions, and visual elements when appropriate

Review content before posting and provide feedback

Analyze TikTok analytics and identify opportunities for improvement

Identify weak points where viewers are likely dropping off

Review top-performing videos and explain why they worked

Study competitors and identify content opportunities

Suggest content ideas based on audience behavior and trends

Improve calls-to-action that increase follows, profile visits, and engagement

Help develop repeatable content formats that can scale

Organize editing workflows and content assets

Ideal Candidate

Proven experience editing TikTok, Reels, or YouTube Shorts

Strong understanding of retention metrics and viewer psychology

Experience growing social media accounts

Strong understanding of hooks, curiosity gaps, storytelling, and audience pain points

Experience with fitness, weight loss, nutrition, coaching, or health content is preferred

Able to explain content decisions using analytics and performance data

Strong English communication skills

Comfortable giving constructive feedback and making strategic recommendations

Long-Term Vision

While my current focus is growing an engaged audience, my long-term goal is to build a coaching business that helps people lose weight through:

Macro coaching

Calorie tracking guidance

Sustainable fat-loss coaching

Workout programming

Accountability and habit-building support

Because of this, I want content that not only generates views and followers, but also builds trust and attracts the type of audience that could eventually become coaching clients.

I am not interested in chasing viral views at the expense of attracting the wrong audience.

When Applying, Please Include

Links to TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube accounts you have helped grow

Before-and-after results or case studies

Examples of short-form videos you have edited

Your process for improving retention and watch time

Your editing software and workflow

Your rate (hourly or per video)

A brief explanation of how you would improve a fitness video focused on weight loss

Bonus Qualifications

Experience working with fitness creators

Experience writing high-performing hooks

Experience analyzing TikTok analytics

Understanding of female weight-loss audiences

Experience helping creators turn followers into coaching clients or customers

Important

When applying, please include one example of a TikTok hook you would write for a video about hidden calories that prevent weight loss. This helps me understand how you think about content strategy and audience psychology.

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

title: Client Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT MANZANO CREATIVE

Manzano Creative is a Canadian content and Meta advertising agency based in Winnipeg, Manitoba. We help service-based businesses — dental clinics, home service companies, and contractors — generate consistent leads through video content and Meta ad campaigns.

We run multiple productions per week, manage active campaigns across multiple clients, and operate as a tight-knit remote team. Our systems run on Slack, Notion, Google Drive, and Meta Ads Manager.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS

We are looking for a Client Operations Manager — someone who wants to grow into a core role inside a fast-moving creative agency.

You will be the main point of contact for our clients. You will manage their campaigns, write their ad copy, keep them informed, and make sure they feel taken care of every single day.

We are not looking for someone who has done everything before. We are looking for someone who is eager to learn, communicates clearly, takes ownership, and genuinely wants to grow with us. We have built out full systems and SOPs for this role — you will be trained on everything.

If you are organised, people-facing, creative, and ready to take on real responsibility — this could be the opportunity you have been looking for.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Client Communication



First point of contact for every client from the 
nt they sign

Monday check-in messages and consistent ongoing communication

Answering client questions and keeping them informed and confident

Coordinating shoot days and delivering content for client review

Monthly performance reporting and results walkthroughs



Campaign Management



Setting up and monitoring Meta ad campaigns

Creating lead forms inside Meta Ads Manager

Flagging performance issues and making optimization suggestions

Ensuring CRM connections and automations are working correctly



Copywriting & Ad Creative



Writing ad scripts for paid ads and nurture videos

Writing primary text and headlines for Meta campaigns

Using AI tools to help generate and refine copy





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Strong written English — clear, warm, and professional

Organised and able to manage multiple clients and priorities at once

Comfortable communicating directly with clients on a daily basis

Able to work independently and take initiative without constant supervision

Willing to learn new tools and systems — we will train you on everything

Reliable internet connection and consistent availability during agreed hours

Comfortable attending weekly tea
etings via video call



Nice to have but not required:



Any experience with Meta Ads Manager or
 advertising

Any background in marketing, copywriting, or client management

Experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT





WHO THRIVES IN THIS ROLE

You are a people person who loves staying organised and keeping things moving. You communicate proactively — you do not wait to be told what to do next. You are excited to learn something new and apply it immediately. You take ownership of your work and genuinely care about doing a good job. You want to be part of a team that is building something real.

If you are looking for a simple task-based role with minimal responsibility — this is not the right fit. This role grows with you and we expect you to grow with it.

????

title: Video Editor – Shorts, Long-Form and Trailers DaVinci Resolve
description:
We want a Video Editor who actually cares - someone who watches tutorials on their days off, studies what's working, and notices when captions are 2 pixels off. If you're constantly learning and improving, keep reading. If you're just looking for any editing job, this isn't it.



You'll edit across three formats:



Short-form clips - Reels, TikToks, Shorts. Finding the best 
nts, crafting hooks, making videos people actually watch.



Long-form episodes - Full podcast edits. Pacing, cuts, audio polish, making hour-long conversations feel tight.



Trailers - Cinematic, high-energy promotional videos (think Diary Of A CEO style). These need real editing chops - dramatic pacing, music, powerful 
nts strung together.



Design matters here. Your videos need to look polished - title cards, captions, graphics, layouts. If you don't have a good eye for design, this role will frustrate you.



This role is right for you if you:



- Are always learning - you seek out new techniques, watch breakdowns, stay curious

- Can edit both quick social clips AND polished long-form content

- Get excited about creating trailers that give people chills

- Have a sharp eye for 
nts that will hit

- Care about design - your captions, titles, and graphics look intentional, not default

- Can work fast without dropping quality

- Take pride in clean, polished edits



The Right Person Will:

- Have a strong portfolio showing range - short-form clips, long-form edits, and ideally trailers or promo videos (no portfolio, no consideration)

- Have a good eye for design - your title cards, captions, and graphics look polished, not like default templates

- Be a genuine learner - you actively improve your skills, seek feedback, and stay on top of what's working

- Know DaVinci Resolve well - multi-cam, colour correction, proxies, basic audio in Fairlight

- Have motion graphics skills - we use Fusion inside Resolve, but After Effects experience transfers (you can learn Fusion quickly)

- Understand short-form trends: hooks, pacing, captions, what works on TikTok/Reels/Shorts

- Know how to edit for emotion - trailers require pacing, music selection, and building to 
nts

- Care about details - no sloppy captions, no audio issues, no "good enough"

- Be a self-starter who manages their own time and hits deadlines

- Stay organized when handling lots of source files and outputs

- Communicate clearly in English (written and spoken)

- Be comfortable with cloud tools and open to AI workflows (transcription, clip finding)

- (Bonus) Have a genuine interest in podcasts or content creation

- (Bonus) Familiar with Figma, Photoshop, Canva, or other design tools for graphics/thumbnails



What You'll Do:



Short-Form Clips:

- Watch long-form podcasts and find the best 
nts for clips

- Edit vertical videos with strong hooks, good pacing, captions, graphics, music, and sound effects

- Keep turnaround times fast while maintaining quality

- Adapt style for different platforms and client brands



Long-Form Episodes:

- Edit full podcast episodes - pacing, cuts, removing dead air, keeping energy up

- Handle multi-cam footage, sync audio/video, colour correction

- Create and work with proxy files for efficient workflows

- Polish audio and ensure consistent levels throughout



Trailers & Promos:

- Create cinematic trailers that build excitement for episodes or shows

- Select the most powerful 
nts and string them together with music and pacing

- Edit for emotion - know when to hit hard and when to breathe

- Think Diary Of A CEO style: high energy, dramatic, makes you want to watch



Quality & Workflow:

- Review your own work carefully before delivery - technical quality, accuracy, brand consistency

- Ensure all design elements look polished - titles, captions, graphics should look intentional

- Keep project files and cloud assets organized

- Work smoothly with the team using our project management and communication tools

- Create thumbnails and graphics when needed (design eye required)



Technical Requirements (Must Have):

- Strong DaVinci Resolve experience (this is mandatory)

- Motion graphics experience - Fusion (preferred) or After Effects (you'll learn Fusion)

- Multi-cam editing experience in Resolve

- Comfortable with proxy workflows

- Basic audio editing (Fairlight is fine)

- Fast, reliable internet (we'll ask for a speed test)

- Powerful editing computer (we'll ask for your specs)

- Familiar with cloud storage (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.)



Bonus Skills (Nice to Have)

- Experience creating trailers or promo videos

- Strong graphic design skills (Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator)

- Advanced motion graphics - complex animations, 3D elements, expressions

- Great music selection instincts - you know what tracks elevate edits

- Advanced audio editing/mixing

- Short-form videos that have performed well on social media

- Experience with AI tools for video workflows



Perks:

Work Hours: Australia time (AEST), with good overlap for Philippines (PHT)

Flexible Schedule: Choose your set hours within the collaborative window

Time Off: Flexible leave policy with reasonable notice

Growth: Opportunities for advancement, raises, and bonuses for consistent quality work

Good Team: Remote, forward-thinking, no micromanagement



About Us:

We're an Australia-based content company that produces podcasts and short-form video. We use DaVinci Resolve, efficient workflows, and focus on delivering quality work at volume.



Salary:



40,000 PHP + per month



If your experience and portfolio justify a higher rate, tell us upfront. We're open to negotiation for the right person.





How to Apply:

Follow these steps carefully (this tests your attention to detail):



 subject line:

Application: Video Editor (Shorts, Long-Form & Trailers) – [Your Full Name]



In your
, write 2–3 sentences about:



Why this role appeals to you

Which format excites you most - clips, long-form, or trailers - and why

What makes you different to other editors

Tell us how you learn:



What's one editing skill you've improved in the last 6 months?

Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!



Application Instructions:



Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."

description:
# Realistic AI Content Creator (Nano Banana Pro & Kling AI)



We're looking for someone who is obsessed with creating AI content that looks completely real.



This is not about generic AI art. Our focus is photorealistic AI influencers, realistic humans, character consistency, and high-quality social media content.



## Important



**This is NOT an entry-level position.**



You must already have experience creating realistic AI humans and AI influencer content. We are looking for someone who can start immediately and does not need to learn the basics from scratch.



If you have never created realistic AI influencers before, this role is not for you.



## Your Tasks



* Create ultra-realistic AI images using Nano Banana Pro

* Create realistic AI videos using Kling AI

* Maintain strong character consistency across all content

* Follow references and creative directions accurately

* Deliver content that looks indistinguishable from real photography



## Requirements



* Proven experience creating realistic AI humans and AI influencer content

* Experience with Nano Banana Pro and/or Kling AI

* Strong prompting skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Understanding of lighting, composition, body proportions, and realism

* Reliable communication and ability to work independently



## Huge Plus



* Character consistency workflows

* Social media content creation

* Basic image editing skills



## To Apply



Please send:



* Your best realistic AI image examples

* Character consistency examples (same character across multiple images)

* A short explanation of your workflow



Start your application with:



**REAL > AI**



so we know you've read everything.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.



You will be joining a brand with a strong, engaged audience of over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,
 followers. Your work will directly contribute to inspiring and uplifting thousands through music.-----The Role: Drive Revenue, Build a Team, Shape a Brand



We are seeking a highly motivated Music Manager to lead our sales, operations, and team development. This is a pivotal role for a professional ready to commit to a 45-50 hour/week position that offers substantial commission potential and a clear path to high earnings.



Key Areas of Impact:

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!



Application Instructions:



Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."
